title.rendered: Best Android emulators for Mac: Compatible with M-series and Intel chips

content.rendered:
A lot of people who use an Android phone as their daily driver or develop apps for Android OS tend to use a Mac as their personal computer. If you are one of them and wish to use Android apps on macOS, all you need is an Android emulator. In this article, I have listed out some of the best Android emulators for Mac that you should use.

Table of Contents
  • The best Android emulators for Mac
    • 1. Android Studio
    • 2. Genymotion – For high performance
    • 3. KO Player – For general use
    • 4. Bluestacks X – The most popular Android emulator
    • 5. NOX Player – For Intel-based Macs
    • 6. ARChon – Cloud Android emulator

The best Android emulators for Mac

Android emulators for Mac have caveats. Some are region-specific, and some don’t support Apple Silicon Macs (M-series chips). I suggest checking each emulator app’s system and regional requirements before downloading. Now, let’s explore these best Android emulators for Mac.

1. Android Studio

While preparing this list of the best Android emulators for Mac, I had not doubt that Android Studio should be my top choice. This emulator is trusted by many developing Android apps on a Mac.

Jointly developed by Google and JetBrains, this emulator boosts Android app development with a comprehensive set of tools for building and testing. Its advanced debugging capabilities and multi-touch gesture support speed up the development process. That’s not all. The emulator integrates with popular tools like Gradle and IntelliJ IDEA quite easily.

Further, Android Studio allows you to create and customize virtual devices with different screen sizes, resolutions, and hardware configurations. All in all, Android Studio continues to be a preferred choice for developers looking to learn app building from scratch and polish their skills.

Pros

  • Very flexible 
  • Integration with the development environment 
  • Extensive development tools 

Cons

  • Limited hardware simulation 

Price: Free

Download

2. Genymotion – For high performance

Offering a professional-grade experience to every Mac user, Genymotion is a reputable Android emulator with decent features that allow you to develop and test apps easily. 

If you’re running something heavy, don’t worry. The OpenGL hardware acceleration support will give you all the speed you need. This emulator comes with popular development tools like Android Studio and Eclipse. As a result, developers can streamline their workflow without depending on any other service. There are also a variety of device configurations and versions to choose from.

From my experience, I believe it is the best choice for test automation, security, application development, VDI, and game development. Don’t let this moment slip away, and learn to simulate a variety of device configurations and versions of Android as you desire.

Pros

  • Android in the Cloud 
  • Social media app support 
  • Application training/demo 
  • Game demo 

Cons

  • No significant cons

Price: 30-day free trial (Subscriptions start at $0.05)

Download

3. KO Player – For general use

If you’re looking for something casual that gets the job done, KO Player is the right consideration. Designed for very general use, this emulator will give you a very neat and lag-free Android experience on your Mac.

While it may not be a performance-extensive choice, it sure has some amazing features. It is perfect for those looking to play games or use apps that are typically only available on Android devices.

KO Player has a built-in video recording feature that allows you to record your screen time. It also has advanced qualities like keyboard mapping and gamepad compatibility, making it ideal for gaming enthusiasts.

There is a built-in Google Play Store, which you can download and enjoy any app you desire. And if you’d like to manage multiple profiles for various use cases, KO Player will do the job smoothly. In my opinion, every Mac user should try this emulator at least once.

Pros

  • Easy and quick download without any trouble 
  • Better gaming performance 
  • Full access to the Play Store 
  • No compatibility challenges

Cons

  • Not performance-centric 
  • May lag occasionally 

Price: Free

Download

4. Bluestacks X – The most popular Android emulator

When anyone thinks of an Android emulator, Bluestacks comes as a top choice. Originally, Bluestacks was only available for Windows PC users. Thankfully, with the latest advancements, even macOS users can enjoy popular Android games on their devices.

Bluestacks’ seamless compatibility with macOS ensures a smooth and efficient game emulation experience. With Bluestacks X running on my Mac, I tried several Android games and was amazed at the smooth performance.

Apart from high performance, the emulator allows various customization options, such as keyboard mapping and power adjustment. Hence, you can personalize your gaming hub to your liking.

With an intuitive design and regular updates, Bluestacks X is a reliable choice for those seeking to run Android apps on their MacBooks. It is a top-notch emulator that caters to the needs of everyone looking for reliability and functionality. However, it is not at the top of my list because its functionality is limited to a few regions.

Pros

  • Supports both Google Play Store and App Store
  • New Cloud Games tab
  • Bug fixes are released regularly
  • Discover trending hits

Cons

  • Limited to a few regions

Price: Free

Download

5. NOX Player – For Intel-based Macs

With impressive features, high performance, and a feature-rich interface, NOX Player is the best Android gaming emulator. It is known to provide a smooth and stable experience while supporting a large game library.

The wide range of customization options will keep you on your toes. NOX Player allows users to customize CPU allocation, RAM size, and resolution settings to optimize performance based on individual preferences. All these factors improve the overall experience significantly.

And that’s not it. If you’re an extensive gamer like me, you will love the gamepad integration feature of this emulator. It lets players add an external controller of their choice and enjoy Android games on Mac like before.

Regardless of your Mac operating system, this emulator will provide you with the best gaming experience. With its extensive support, NOX Player stands out as a reliable and efficient Android emulator for Mac.

Pros

  • Over 10 million+ users
  • Highest performance
  • Extreme compatibility

Cons

  • Not compatible Apple Silicon Macs

Price: Free

Download

6. ARChon – Cloud Android emulator

Last but not least, if you don’t want to burden your Mac with an Android emulator app, try ARChon. Unlike traditional emulators, ARChon allows users to run Android apps on their Mac without needing a separate virtual machine. It runs on Google Chrome.

Even though this is a cloud emulator, do not mistake it for something casual. This emulator is known for its seamless performance, allowing users to experience smooth and lag-free app emulation.

ARChon also offers many customization options, such as adjusting screen resolution and orientation to tailor the experience to individual preferences. If necessary, it also allows you to install third-party APK files on the cloud itself.

Such features make ARChon a popular choice among developers and tech enthusiasts alike. Overall, it stands out as a top-tier Android emulator for Mac users seeking a high-quality experience with minimal hassle.

Pros

  • Browser-centric emulator
  • Does not require processing power
  • Perfect for minimal use

Cons

  • Slower compared to apps

Price: Free

Download

Welcome Android on Mac!

In conclusion, Android emulators for Macs offer a great way to experience Android apps and games on a larger screen. Each emulator has unique features and capabilities, making it a great choice depending on your needs and preferences.

Which Android emulator will you download for your Mac? Do let me know in the comments below!

Read more:

  • Best iOS Emulators for PC
  • Best Windows emulators for Mac
  • Best SNES Emulators for Mac

title.rendered: Best iPhone 16 Cases to Buy in 2026

content.rendered:
The iPhone 16 lineup continues the legacy of Apple’s iconic design, boasting a stunning display and an advanced camera setup. Of course, you’ll want to keep your device safe from everyday wear and tear with a protective case. The good news is that there’s a wide range of choices, from rugged protectors to sleek, minimalist designs made from different materials.

But deciding which option is right for you can be challenging. That’s why I’ve crafted this in-depth guide to help you pick the best case for your iPhone 16, 16 Plus, 16 Pro, or 16 Pro Max, based on your unique needs. See my top recommendations below, with detailed insights into what makes them great buys.

What to Look for in an iPhone 16 Case

From experience, I’ve learned that choosing an iPhone case is not an easy decision. There are many things to consider before hitting the buy button. Here are the criteria I always look for and which you should, too.

  • Protection: This is the most important factor when choosing an iPhone case. Look for drop protection and impact resistance from materials such as TPU or polycarbonate to shield your phone from drops and shocks. Durability is key: the case must last and protect your iPhone.
  • MagSafe Compatibility: This is essential for seamless wireless charging and using accessories like MagSafe wallets with your iPhone. Cases with built-in magnets allow for easy attachment of MagSafe chargers, wallets, or stands without affecting charging speed or alignment.
  • Style & Design: Nobody wants an ugly-looking case. Style matters because your case reflects your taste. However, the design should also balance aesthetics with functionality, offering protection without compromising appearance.
  • Grip & Comfort: This is often overlooked, but it’s incredibly important for day-to-day performance. The grip affects how easy your phone is to hold. Look for cases with textured grips to reduce slips, and that fit comfortably in your hand, ensuring the phone is both safe and easy to use in everyday situations.
  • Additional Features: Many cases include extra features such as card slots, built-in kickstands, or screen protectors that can add convenience. These extras offer practical benefits but might not be available to everyone.

6 Best Cases for iPhone 16, 16e, 16 Plus, 16 Pro, and 16 Pro Max

Now that you know how to choose the right case for your iPhone 16 series, here’s a list of some of the best cases you can currently buy.

1. Spigen Tough Armor Case: Best Overall

A military-grade protective case with a built-in kickstand for hands-free viewing, great when watching videos or on video calls. Durable mix of PC, TPU, and XRD Impact Foam keeps your phone safe from drops, while raised edges protect the screen and camera. Moreover, you can use MagSafe accessories and wireless charging with the case on.

Spigen also offers multiple case options such as Thin Fit, Clear, Rugged Armor, etc. So,

Best choice for: Everyday users who want reliable protection plus a built-in stand for easy hands-free use.

Check out on Amazon

2. ESR HaloLock Cyber Tough Case: Superior Drop Protection

If your phone often slips out of your hands, this ESR iPhone 16 Cyber Tough case is a must-have. It has a three-layer structure that offers military-grade protection from bumps and 23-ft falls. The HaloLock magnets make MagSafe charging and accessory use effortless. You will also receive a versatile camera stand to protect lenses and enable hands-free viewing.

For a slimmer and transparent look, go for the ESR Classic Hybrid case.

Best choice for: Travelers and people who need strong protection and easy MagSafe support without bulk.

Check out on Amazon 

3. OtterBox Symmetry Series Leather Case: Premium Style for Your iPhone 16

Here’s a stylish and protective MagSafe-ready case that blends everyday defense with a premium feel. This OtterBox Symmetry Series case uses cactus leather that’s soft to the touch and resists stains and scratches. I preferred the enchanted garden version for the beautiful embroidery. It also has strong built-in MagSafe magnets for easy wireless charging and includes metal buttons and an inner felt backing for an upscale feel.

Best choice: If style matters as much as function.

Check out on Amazon 

4. FNTCASE iPhone 16 Clear Case: Flaunt Your Style

Looking for a clear case for your iPhone 16? FNTCASE offers a budget-friendly slim case that preserves your phone’s original look. It has airbag corners and a buffer bumper to absorb 10ft drops. The best part is its nano-antioxidant layer, which resists stains, sweat, and fingerprints, so your case never turns yellow.

Thanks to the integrated magnets, you can enjoy MagSafe charging. The case also includes a screen protector to protect your display from scratches.

Best choice for: Buyers who want simple, see-through protection without spending much.

Check out on Amazon 

5. Miracase Bumper iPhone 16 Case: Full-Body Protection

A full-body protective case with a built-in 9H tempered glass screen protector, ideal for maximum coverage. Its dual-layer rugged bumper build keeps your phone safe from heavy impacts and 12ft drops. The back cover is made of HD polycarbonate for a clear, sleek look and features integrated magnets for MagSafe accessories and charging.

Best choice for: Anyone who prioritizes top-to-bottom protection and doesn’t mind a bit of bulk.

Check out on Amazon 

6. TOCOL Ultra Slim Case: Sleek Yet Protective

We’ll love how the iPhone 16 looks sleek and stylish. To showcase its original design, get the TOCOL translucent matte case, designed to protect your phone. Its TPU cushioning material and four-layer shock-absorbing structure give good drop protection. However, the case is only 0.05 inches thick and features a non-slip matte finish for easy grip.

Best choice for: Good protection with magnetic support in a stylish matte look.

Check out on Amazon 

Quick Overview: Which Case Should You Buy?

How to Choose the Right Case for Your iPhone 16

Ultimately, the best iPhone 16 case is the one that fits your lifestyle. If you’re always on the move or prone to dropping your device, a rugged or full-body case is a good choice. If you prefer something lightweight and clean, a slim or clear case will do the job. And if style matters as much as protection, premium leather or translucent designs are worth considering.

Think about how you actually use your phone day-to-day, and you’ll end up with a case that feels right from the first snap-on. If you still have questions, let me know in the comments below, and I’ll be happy to answer them.

Video: Best cases for iPhone 16 series

Signing off…

Hopefully, all the research and testing I’ve done has helped you out. I’ll be adding more iPhone 16 cases to this roundup as I find them, so check back for more recommendations. In the meantime, if you still have questions, let me know in the comments below, and I’ll be happy to answer them.

Check out other articles:

  • iPhone 16 vs iPhone 15: Which iPhone is best for you?
  • Best screen protectors for iPhone 16 and 16 Pro
  • 8 must-have accessories for your all-new iPhone 16e
  • Best iPhone 16e cases for drop protection and everyday use!

When not typing away on her MacBook Pro, she loves being lost in a book or out exploring the world.

@graph.name: ESR Cyber Tough Case with Stash Stand
@graph.description: With dual layers and military-grade protection, this case is sure to keep your phone safe from drops and scratches. Its standout feature is the built-in stash stand, which doubles as a MagSafe-compatible kickstand for hands-free use and easy wireless charging. Of course, there are also precise cutouts for easy access to ports and buttons. You can choose from five color options to match your phone, namely black, blue, green, pink, and light grey.

@graph.name: Spigen Tough Armor AI (MagFit) – Best iPhone 16 case with stand
@graph.description: Tough Armor AI is another top case for the iPhone 16 series. It comes from one of my favorite brands, Spigen, and sports a sleek futuristic design that packs military-grade protection to keep your device safe in case of drops. Spigen says it has analyzed thousands of impact data and added the XRD foam on every corner of the case to enhance the protection. What’s more, the Tough Armor AI case is MagSafe-compatible, ensuring seamless charging for your convenience. It also has a minimalist built-in kickstand, which is ideal for propping your phone up for hands-free viewing.

@graph.name: Pitaka Classic Ultra Slim Case – Best slim iPhone 16 case
@graph.description: If you’re a minimalist, the Classic Ultra Slim Case from Pitaka is the best case for your iPhone 16! It’s super slim and crafted from lightweight aramid fiber that gives a unique finish. I love the feel of it in my hand! Of course, it’s also MagSafe compatible, so you can use your MagSafe charger or accessories without any problem. This slim iPhone 16 case is available in four fun patterns besides the classic black.

@graph.name: Apple Silicone Case with MagSafe – Best soft silicone case for iPhone 16
@graph.description: This list would be incomplete without mentioning Apple’s original silicone case for the iPhone 16. I love the soft-touch finish and the interior microfiber lining, which provides a plush home for your device. It’s designed for excellent everyday protection and seamless compatibility with MagSafe. You can choose from eight color options, ranging from bright to dark, so there’s something for everyone.

@graph.name: Totallee Clear Grip Case – Best clear iPhone 16 case
@graph.description: If you want to show off your iPhone 16 in all its original glory, the Totallee case is worth getting. It’s ultra-thin yet offers ample protection from dust and scratches. So, you can keep your iPhone safe while also enjoying its look. This case is also MagSafe compatible and has extra grip to make sure your phone stays securely in your hand!

@graph.name: Mujjo Full Leather Case – Best leather case for iPhone 16
@graph.description: If you’re after a super classy look, Mujjo has got your back. I’ve always loved their premium leather cases, which add a professional touch to your device. These are made of full-grain calfskin leather, which is ultra-soft and durable. But it’s not just about the looks. The case protects your phone with raised bezels around the screen and a robust machined-metal rear camera bump. There are five beautiful color options.

@graph.name: i-Blason Armorbox Case – Best full-body case for iPhone 16
@graph.description: Here’s an iPhone 16 case for ultimate heavy-duty protection! True to its name, the i-Blason Armorbox case is like a shield for your device that can defend against drops, knocks, and everything else. The full-body design includes a built-in screen protector and a handy camera cover that doubles as a kickstand. It also comes with a belt clip holster for easy mobility. It’s definitely a no-nonsense case that’s perfect for carefree use. However, the one downside is that although it works with wireless charging, this case is not MagSafe compatible.

@graph.name: SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle MAG – Best budget iPhone 16 case with drop protection
@graph.description: This one’s another robust choice! The SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle provides rugged, dual-layer protection, a built-in screen protector, and reinforced bumpers for heavy-duty drop defense. Moreover, the transparent back showcases the phone’s design while ensuring full MagSafe compatibility. It is available in three color options and comes with a one-year warranty.

@graph.name: dBrand Grip – Customizable case for iPhone 16
@graph.description: Amp up the safety of your iPhone with the ultra-sturdy dBrand case, which provides military-grade protection in a super sleek design. It’s minimal yet oh, so reliable. It also works seamlessly with MagSafe charging and accessories. The best part is that you can customize it with a dBrand skin to add a unique personal touch.

@graph.name: Caseology Capella Mag – Best cheap MagSafe case for iPhone 16
@graph.description: If you want a reliable yet cheap clear case for your iPhone 16, check out the Caseology Capella Mag Case. It features a smooth, matte finish that feels premium in hand while offering enhanced grip. The slim yet sturdy case provides military-grade drop protection without adding bulk. Moreover, the raised bezels safeguard the screen and camera from direct impact. Of course, it’s also MagSafe compatible, like all the other cases on this list.

title.rendered: How to make your AirPods announce notifications

content.rendered:
With so many apps installed on your iPhone, it is common to receive tons of important notifications, requiring you to glance at your iPhone’s display. However, checking notifications can quickly become inconvenient when driving, working out, or multitasking.

Fortunately, with the Announce Notifications feature, you can make your AirPods announce notifications to ensure you never miss an important message or alert. Keep reading to learn how to enable and customize Announce Notifications on AirPods.

Table of Contents
  • What is iPhone's Announce Notifications feature?
  • Devices and AirPods that support Announce Notifications
  • How to enable Announce Notifications on AirPods
  • Choose which notifications Siri announce on AirPods
  • Respond to notifications with AirPods
  • How to turn off AirPods from announcing notifications temporarily

What is iPhone’s Announce Notifications feature?

Announce Notifications is an iOS feature that allows Siri to read incoming notifications from apps through your iPhone’s built-in speaker or paired AirPods (or other compatible headphones). This can be particularly useful when you are doing something that requires minimal interruption or when your iPhone is in your pocket or kept away.

Devices and AirPods that support Announce Notifications

Unfortunately, not all iPhones and AirPods support Announce Notifications. You will need a compatible iPhone and a pair of compatible headphones to benefit from this feature. Here are the devices:

  • An iPhone running on iOS 15 or later
  • AirPods (2nd generation or later), AirPods Pro (1st and 2nd generation), AirPods Max

How to enable Announce Notifications on AirPods

Once you are sure that your iPhone and AirPods support the Announce Notifications feature, you can enable it using these steps:

  1. Open Settings and go to Apple Intelligence & Siri or Siri.
  2. Locate and tap Announce Notifications.
  3. Next, toggle on Announce Notifications.
  4. Now, choose whether you want the Notifications to be announced when connected to headphones and/or CarPlay.

  5. Alternatively, you can head to Notifications > Announce Notifications to set up the feature.

Once set up, Siri will announce any new notifications or messages on the compatible AirPods model. If you want to stop Siri from reading messages on AirPods, you can follow the above steps and turn off the Announce Notifications toggle. In addition to notifications, you can also make Siri announce calls on your AirPods, so you won’t have to pull out the iPhone from your pocket every time a call is received.

Here’s how you can do this:

  1. Head to the Apple Intelligence & Siri settings and tap Announce Calls.
  2. Next, select when and how you want Siri to announce incoming calls.

After you do this, Siri will announce any incoming call on your AirPods, and you can respond to it by simply saying Hey Siri or Siri.

Choose which notifications Siri announce on AirPods

By default, Apple has set the Announce Notifications feature off for each individual app on your iPhone. So, simply enabling Announce Notifications will do you no good. Instead, you must enable Announce Notifications for each app you want Siri to read aloud notifications from into your AirPods.

Let me show you how to do this:

  1. Open Settings and head to Notifications Settings.
  2. Tap Announce Notifications.

  3. Next, select the app from which you want to hear notifications on AirPods under the Announce Notifications From section.
  4. Toggle on Announce Notifications.
  5. Select what type of notifications you want to hear on your AirPods.

Also, within the Announce Notifications settings, you can choose whether you want Siri to send replies without asking for confirmation each time. To do so, toggle on Reply Without Confirmation.

Note While this is useful for quick replies, it might lead to errors if Siri misinterprets your message.

Respond to notifications with AirPods

Now that you have enabled Announce Notifications for AirPods, you no longer need to pick up your iPhone to respond to a notification or message. All you need to do is ask Siri to do it for you. Here’s how you do it:

  • Make sure you are wearing the AirPods, and they are connected to your iPhone.
  • Now, every time a new notification arrives, Siri will chime and then read the notification aloud.
  • To reply, simply say, Reply, followed by your message.
  • Now, depending on whether you have the Reply Without Confirmation setting enabled, Siri will send the reply. Otherwise, Siri will confirm and then send the reply.

How to turn off AirPods from announcing notifications temporarily

Although you can head to Apple Intelligence & Siri or Notifications settings to stop AirPods from announcing notifications, the process is quite tedious. Luckily, Apple lets you add an Announce Notifications toggle to the Control Center, which temporarily stops AirPods from announcing notifications. Here’s how to add and use it:

  1. Swipe down from the top-right corner of the screen to pull down the Control Center on your iPhone.
  2. Tap and hold any empty area to customize the Control Center.
  3. Next, tap Add a Control, search for the Announce Notifications control, and tap on it to add it to the Control Center.

Now that you have added the Announce Notifications control to the Control Center, you can use it to temporarily pause Announce Notifications.

Enjoy hands-free convenience

With Siri reading notifications for you on your AirPods, you can stay connected while keeping your hands and eyes free for other tasks that require more attention. So, go ahead and enable the feature on your iPhone. Be sure to turn off the Announce Notifications feature for apps that aren’t very important to you to minimize disruption.

Did this guide answer all your queries? Do share your experience in the comments.

FAQs

How do I get my AirPods to make a call?

While wearing your AirPods, simply say, Hey Siri, call [name], and Siri will make the call.

Why are my AirPods not announcing caller names?

For your AirPods to announce caller names, you must have Announce Calls set to Headphones Only or Headphones & Car.

You may also like to read these:

  • How to find your lost AirPods in any scenario
  • How to update your AirPods to the latest firmware version
  • How to turn off Siri on AirPods

title.rendered: How to stop apps from opening at startup on Mac

content.rendered:
Ah, that dreadful sight of apps opening the moment you boot up your Mac! It used to be excruciatingly painful for me, too.

First, it slowed down my Mac. Second, since these apps kept running in the background and eating up memory, it took my Mac forever to go full throttle.

Finally, after trying and testing a few built-in options and a third-party app, I managed to completely stop Mac apps from opening at startup. Below, I have shared all my findings and solutions to help you avoid the issue or put an end to it. Take a look.

Table of Contents
  • Why do certain Mac apps open at startup?
  • How to stop Mac apps from opening at startup in macOS Sonoma
    • 1. Use a startup utility app like CleanMyMac X
    • 2. Temporarily disable apps opening at startup on Mac
    • 3. How to stop Mac apps from launching on startup from Dock
    • 4. How to remove startup apps in System Settings
    • 5. Remove Launch Daemons and Launch Agents
    • 6. Disable apps from opening at startup from app settings

Why do certain Mac apps open at startup?

Negligence. When installing apps, we tend to be in a hurry and hit continue/skip without reading what the dialog box says. App developers smartly place the “Start at login/launch” option above Install Now, which results in many Mac apps starting automatically after logging in.

Another reason apps open at launch is if you have added apps to your Login Items. While chances are you did this by choice, you should remove startup items you no longer need or recognize.

How to stop Mac apps from opening at startup in macOS Sonoma

In this article, I have outlined all the possible ways to stop apps from opening when you start up your Mac.

Although the most convenient way to do it is from System Settings, you must take a few more precautionary steps to prevent the problem from recurring. These include manually finding and removing Launch Agents.

If you find the latter time-consuming, you should consider using a Mac cleaner app that can effortlessly remove login items, Launch Agents files, and other unwanted stuff to speed up your Mac.

1. Use a startup utility app like CleanMyMac X

The best way to manage your login apps and programs is to use a startup manager utility app like CleanMyMac X.

To get started, you need to download CleanMyMac X and install the app on your Mac. I recommend using the 7-day free trial to familiarize yourself with the app.

After launching the app, you must add login credentials, enter payment details, and provide the app with the necessary permissions.

Once you finish the formalities, CleanMyMac’s intuitive UI will make removing login items a breeze. Here’s how:

  1. Launch CleanMyMac → Select Optimization from the home page.
  2. Select View All (number) Items to see login items.

  3. Now, select Login Items → Click Remove.
    If you don’t want to remove all items, you can select particular login items in the right pane and hit Remove.

  4. Further, you can go to Launch Agents and remove unnecessary app files that are eating up your space and starting apps independently.

The good thing about CleanMyMac is that if you installed a new app and are unaware that it has been added to your login items, the app will detect it. Regularly checking this part of the CleanMyMac app will help you mitigate the issue at the source.

Now, if you don’t wish to download another app to manage login items, you can make use of the built-in options provided by macOS.

2. Temporarily disable apps opening at startup on Mac

Suppose you don’t want to permanently disable apps; you just don’t want it to appear the next time you log in. In that case, there’s a cheeky macOS trick you can try.

After typing your login password, hold down the shift key and then hit return. Keep holding the shift key until the Dock appears. This will temporarily stop the login items from appearing.

To permanently stop apps from appearing, you can disable the function from your Dock or System Settings, as shown below.

3. How to stop Mac apps from launching on startup from Dock

Need a two-click solution to stop apps from launching? Disable it from your Dock.

  1. Right-click on the app in the Dock.
  2. Go to Options.
  3. De-select Open at Login to remove the tick mark next to it.

4. How to remove startup apps in System Settings

If too many apps open at launch, you need to fix the issue from System Settings.

  1. Go to Apple menu → System Settings.
  2. Click General in the sidebar → Pick Login Items from the right.

  3. Now, hold down the shift key and click on apps to select them.
  4. Click minus (-) to remove them.

Additionally, look for apps in the Allow in the Background box. Toggle off any app that could make your Mac sluggish.

If you wish to complete this process on older macOS versions, you need to go to System Preferences → Users & Groups → Login Items.

5. Remove Launch Daemons and Launch Agents

After trying the above, if apps are still opening at launch, you must remove Launch Daemons and Launch Agents. Both these run in the background at the system level to independently enable the automatic opening of apps.

The catch here is you won’t find them in your usual folders. You’ll have to dig deeper.

  1. Open Finder → Click Go in the menu bar → Pick Go to Folder.

  2. Search for /Library/LaunchAgents/ and /Library/LaunchDaemons/ one after the other.

  3. Open each folder one after the other and trash the files you don’t recognize.

Repeat this process once in a while to ensure no Launch Agent is able to automatically run apps on your Mac.

6. Disable apps from opening at startup from app settings

Apart from using System Preferences in macOS to manage startup items, you can also prevent specific apps from launching at startup by adjusting their in-app settings. Many apps, particularly cloud storage services, and music streaming apps have built-in options to disable automatic startup.

While the exact steps to access and modify these settings can vary between apps, it generally involves navigating to the app’s preferences or settings menu and locating an option related to startup behavior or background processes.

For instance, here’s how you can access these settings in the Dropbox app for Mac:

  1. Click the Dropbox app icon located on the Menu Bar at the top.
  2. Click your profile picture on the top-right and go to Preferences.

  3. Then, In the General tab, toggle off Open Dropbox upon startup.

Conclusion

After implementing the above solutions, apps will no longer bother you or your Mac at startup. In fact, you’ll notice a considerable change in speed when you restart your Mac.

Did you find this guide helpful? I’d like to hear your thoughts in the comments below.

  • How to change the default app for file types on Mac
  • What is CCXProcess on Mac, and how to remove it from your Mac?

title.rendered: Best Bluetooth Headphones for iPad Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
iPad Pro was the first iPad to ditch the headphone jack. And for that reason, the wireless headphone is could be the best companion of the iPad Pro. So whether you’re thinking of getting Apple’s own AirPods Pro or some other brand and style of Bluetooth headphones, we’ve got you covered in this post. Let’s check out the best wireless headphones for iPad Pro.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple AirPods Pro 3
  • 2. Powerbeats Pro Wireless Earphones
  • 3. TREBLAB Z2 Active Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones
  • 4. New Apple AirPods Max – Sky Blue
  • 5. TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds
  • 6. Soundcore
  • 7. TOZO T6 Waterproof Wireless Earbuds
  • 8. PowerLocus Wireless Bluetooth Over-Ear Foldable Headphones
  • Summing Up…

1. Apple AirPods Pro 3

For an overall superior sound experience, nothing compares to the AirPods Pro. They offer active noise cancellation for the immersive sound that’ll keep you hooked. The special transparency mode helps you to hear and stay connected with the world around you too. It’s certainly a unique feature! 

Further, these come in three sizes of soft, tapered silicone tips for a custom fit. They’re sweat and water-resistant to be a great companion in all situations. Moreover, they seamlessly connect with all your other Apple devices and have quick access to Siri. Finally, the wireless charging case delivers more than 24 hours of battery life.

Pros

  • Best sound experience 
  • Lightweight 
  • Waterproof 
  • Comfortable custom fit

Cons

  • Expensive 
  • Small size so can be easily misplaced

Check out on Amazon

2. Powerbeats Pro Wireless Earphones

For those looking for a high-end experience with no compromises, the Powerbeats Pro stands out as one of the best wireless headphones for iPad Pro and all devices. They’re sleek and designed for sweat & water resistance during tough workouts or running. They feature the Apple H1 Headphone Chip and Class 1 Bluetooth for extended range and fewer dropouts.

Further, you can enjoy up to 9 hours of listening time with secure-fit ear hooks for lightweight comfort and stability. With the charging case, you’ll get more than 24 hours of playback time. You can have ultimate control by choosing to play in the right, left, or both earbuds at a time.

Pros

  • Sleek
  • Powerful and high-quality sound
  • Customization options like one-ear play
  • Water-resistance

Cons

  • Expensive

Check out on Amazon

3. TREBLAB Z2 Active Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones

Whether you’re running outside or on a treadmill, lifting weights, or playing basketball, these over-ear workout headphones are the perfect companion. IPX4 water-resistant & sweatproof, these running headphones survive intense fitness sessions. Just set your iPad Pro near you and enjoy music or podcasts while staying active. 

The premium, ultra-soft materials used in these headphones mold your ear’s natural shape for a custom fit. The buttons are easy to reach and control. You can smoothly combine work and workout hands-free with these wireless headphones for iPad Pro.

Pros

  • 35-hour battery
  • Designed for sport
  • Voice-assistant support

Cons

  • Expensive

Check out on Amazon

4. New Apple AirPods Max – Sky Blue

Apple’s premium over-ear headphones are the best match for your iPad Pro. They offer an unbeatable sound quality with high-fidelity audio and active noise cancellation. At the same time, spatial audio with dynamic head tracking provides theater-like surround sound to keep you immersed in your calls and media or other work.

Further, it’s got a sleek look with a knit-mesh canopy and memory foam ear cushions for superior comfort and exceptional fit. Lastly, the computational audio merges custom acoustic design with Apple’s H1 chip and software for impressive audio every time. The beautiful colors are just the cherry on top!

Pros

  • High-fidelity audio
  • Designed by Apple so excellent quality
  • Long-lasting comfort
  • Sleek look

Cons

  • Pricey

Check out on Amazon

5. TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds



If you’re looking for compact wireless headphones for your iPad Pro, you’ll love this set’s authentic sound and powerful bass performance. It has an 8 mm-sized speaker driver – the drive area is 1.77 times the usual drive area for an enhanced listening experience!

With Bluetooth 5.3, these wireless earbuds can last for over 15 hours’ playtime from a single charge and 55 hours in the compact charging case. Moreover, the buds and case are both waterproof for 1 meter deep for 30 minutes. That makes them ideal for sweating it out at the gym. Plus, it’s easy to wash them when needed.

Pros

  • Lightweight
  • Powerful bass
  • Waterproof
  • Color options

Check out on Amazon

6. Soundcore

Maintain your focus and get more done with the hybrid active noise cancellation on these premium yet affordable headphones. They boast dual noise-detecting microphones that pick up and filter out over 90% of low-frequency ambient sound so that nothing distracts you from your music.

Further, you can customize the noise cancellation with three modes: Transport minimizes airplane engine noise while Outdoor reduces traffic sound and wind, and Indoor dampens the sound of busy workspaces with people talking in the background. So they’re the ideal pair of headphones to keep you company anywhere, anytime.

Moreover, you can enjoy up to 40 hours of music in noise-canceling mode and 60 hours in standard mode. A quick 5-minute charge gives you 4 hours of listening.

Pros

  • Customizable noise cancellation
  • Good battery life
  • Three color options

Cons

  • Headset buttons might not work when connected to iOS devices.

Check out on Amazon

7. TOZO T6 Waterproof Wireless Earbuds

For a stellar combination of style and quality, check out these TOZO Bluetooth headphones. They offer a wonderful authentic sound experience. The nano-coating makes them waterproof for 1 meter for 30 minutes. So it is suitable for sports, workouts, or even singing in the rain.

Further, you can wash them to keep them good as new! Lastly, these wireless earbuds for your iPad Pro and other devices can last for over 6 hours’ playtime from a single charge. This increases to over 24 extra hours in the compact charging case. Choose from 3 classic colors.

Pros

  • Compact and lightweight
  • Waterproof and washable
  • 3 color options

Cons

  • A little pricey

Check out on Amazon

8. PowerLocus Wireless Bluetooth Over-Ear Foldable Headphones 

The ergonomic design of these wireless Bluetooth headphones will keep your ears feeling comfy as you enjoy your favorite tunes. They’re also foldable and with stretchable sides to fit both adults and children. The portable design makes them a breeze to carry with you every day.

The deep bass combined with dynamic power sound results in superior audio quality, even in the lowest volume levels. Further, there is an in-built mic for hands-free calls and voice assistant control. Moreover, you can choose from eight beautiful color options to match your preference.

Pros

  • Foldable
  • Affordable
  • Color options
  • Built-in mic
  • 45 Days Money Back Offer

Cons

  • No noise reduction

Check out on Amazon

Summing Up…

With so much variety, it’s easy to find the right Bluetooth headphones for your needs. There’s something for every budget and style. Let us know your choice in the comments below

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

@graph.name: iGeeksBlog
@graph.description: iGeeksBlog is your global go-to source for Apple, tech, and gaming. Get the latest news, reviews, and tips to stay ahead in the fast-paced tech world.

@graph.name: Mehak Siddiqui
@graph.description: Mehak has a master’s degree in communication and over ten years of writing experience. Her passion for technology and Apple products led her to iGeeksBlog, where she specializes in writing product roundups and app recommendations for fellow Apple users. When not typing away on her MacBook Pro, she loves being lost in a book or out exploring the world.

@graph.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3 Wireless Earbuds
@graph.description: For an overall superior sound experience, nothing compares to the AirPods Pro. They offer active noise cancellation for the immersive sound that’ll keep you hooked. The special transparency mode helps you to hear and stay connected with the world around you too.

@graph.name: Beats Powerbeats Pro Wireless Earbuds
@graph.description: For those looking for a high-end experience with no compromises, the Powerbeats Pro stands out as one of the best wireless headphones. They’re sleek and designed for sweat & water resistance during tough workouts or running. They feature the Apple H1 Headphone Chip and Class 1 Bluetooth for extended range and fewer dropouts.

@graph.name: TREBLAB Z2 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Workout Headphones
@graph.description: Whether you’re running outside or on a treadmill, lifting weights, or playing basketball, these over-ear workout headphones are the perfect companion. IPX4 water-resistant & sweatproof, these running headphones survive intense fitness sessions.

@graph.name: TOZO T10 Wireless Earbuds Bluetooth 5.3 Headphones
@graph.description: If you’re looking for compact wireless headphones for your iPad Pro, you’ll love this set’s authentic sound and powerful bass performance. It has an 8 mm-sized speaker driver, with Bluetooth 5.3, these wireless earbuds can last for over 15 hours’ playtime from a single charge and 55 hours in the compact charging case.

@graph.name: Soundcore Q30 by Anker
@graph.description: Maintain your focus and get more done with the hybrid active noise cancellation on these premium yet affordable headphones. They boast dual noise-detecting microphones that pick up and filter out over 90% of low-frequency ambient sound so that nothing distracts you from your music.

@graph.name: TOZO T6 Wireless Earbuds
@graph.description: For a stellar combination of style and quality, check out these TOZO Bluetooth headphones. They offer a wonderful authentic sound experience. The nano-coating makes them waterproof for 1 meter for 30 minutes.

@graph.name: PowerLocus Wireless Bluetooth Over-Ear Stereo Foldable Headphones
@graph.description: The ergonomic design of these wireless Bluetooth headphones will keep your ears feeling comfy as you enjoy your favorite tunes. They’re also foldable and with stretchable sides to fit both adults and children.

title.rendered: How to turn off Apple Intelligence on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

content.rendered:
Let’s be honest; not everyone cares or is excited about AI on their devices. A recent survey also suggests that 73% of Apple users think Apple Intelligence adds little to no value to their device experience.

While Apple Intelligence features like Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence can speed up your workflow and improve your knowledge, some users might prefer not to use them due to privacy concerns. Fortunately, Apple allows you to disable Apple Intelligence on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Keep reading to learn how.

Table of Contents
  • Why you might want to disable Apple Intelligence?
  • How to turn off Apple Intelligence
    • On iPhone and iPad
    • On Mac
  • How to turn off specific Apple Intelligence features on iPhone
  • How to stop Apple Intelligence from learning from a specific app on iPhone

Why you might want to disable Apple Intelligence?

While you may have your own reasons why you no longer want Apple Intelligence, here are some of the common reasons why most users are looking to disable Apple Intelligence on their devices:

  • Privacy concerns: Apple has already said that all Apple Intelligence tasks are processed on the device, and the ones that require cloud are secured in Private Cloud Compute. However, not all users are comfortable sharing their data with Apple servers, whether for a fraction of a second or a minute.
  • Performance issues: Not all users can afford the Pro models, and it wouldn’t be wrong to say the non-pro iPhone models are infamous for their poor battery life. And since all Apple Intelligence features are resource-consuming, your iPhone battery may drain way faster than it used to before.
  • Low storage: Gone are the days when a mere 128GB of storage space was enough. However, it is still the maximum available base storage space on iPhone models that support Apple Intelligence. Thus, some users may prefer to use this valuable storage in some better way rather than keeping occupied with AI features they don’t even use.

How to turn off Apple Intelligence

While Apple Intelligence was introduced to revolutionize how you interact with your Apple devices, the issue is that Apple automatically enables all its features when you turn it on for the first time. Also, Apple Intelligence is still in its nascent stage, so it can sometimes deliver wrong information, such as wrong Notification Summaries, making a strong case in favor of turning off Apple Intelligence on your device. Let’s jump in to see how you can turn it off on different Apple devices:

On iPhone and iPad

You can turn off Apple Intelligence on an iPhone or iPad like this:

  1. Open Settings and head to Apple Intelligence & Siri.
  2. Toggle off Apple Intelligence.
  3. Finally, tap the Turn off Apple Intelligence button on the pop-up menu that appears.

On Mac

Turning off Apple Intelligence on a Mac is pretty similar, too:

  1. Open the System Settings app and select Apple Intelligence & Siri in the left pane.
  2. Click the toggle next to Apple Intelligence to turn it off.

  3. Click Turn off Apple Intelligence on the confirmation prompt to confirm turning off Apple Intelligence.

How to turn off specific Apple Intelligence features on iPhone

While you can disable Apple Intelligence altogether, it’s possible to turn off a few features, such as Writing Tools, individually, if you don’t find them particularly useful.

For example, you can turn off text summaries in the Messages app notifications by heading to Settings → Apps → Messages and toggling off Summarize Messages.

How to stop Apple Intelligence from learning from a specific app on iPhone

Apple has, by default, enabled Apple Intelligence to learn how you use each app on your iPhone to help it deliver valuable suggestions across the apps. However, it isn’t wrong to be uncomfortable sharing your app usage data with Apple to help improve Apple Intelligence.

Fortunately, Apple allows you to disable Apple Intelligence from accessing how you use an app on your iPhone. However, you must do this individually for every app, as there’s no universal switch. Here’s how to do this:

  1. Open Settings, scroll down to the bottom, and tap Apps.
  2. Here, select the app from which you don’t want Apple Intelligence to learn from your usage habits.
  3. Next, tap Apple Intelligence & Siri.
  4. Toggle off Learn from this App on the subsequent menu.

Signing off…

That’s how easy it is to disable Apple Intelligence on your Apple devices. Once done, your iPhone or Mac will now operate as usual with no resource-consuming AI features running in the background. If, for some reason, in the future, you decide you want to use AI features, you can head to the appropriate settings app on your device and re-enable Apple Intelligence.

Which Apple Intelligence feature do you love or are disappointed with the most? Do share your thoughts in the comments.

Also read:

  • How to turn off Siri Suggestions on iPhone and Mac
  • Turn off Private Browsing on iPhone: A guide for Safari and Chrome
  • How to get Visual Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro models

title.rendered: How to use Touch ID on your Mac (Setup guide)

content.rendered:
Touch ID has become essential on Mac. It offers a convenient way to unlock your Mac, make secure purchases, and even autofill passwords with just a touch of your finger. If you’re new to Touch ID or want to set it up on your Magic Keyboard, you’re at the right place. In this guide, I will share how to set up and use Touch ID on your MacBook, so you can enjoy faster and safer access to your device.

Table of Contents
  • What is Touch ID on Mac?
  • How to set up Touch ID on Mac
  • How to rename or delete fingerprints on Mac
    • Rename a fingerprint
    • Delete a fingerprint
  • What you can do with Touch ID on your Mac
    • 1. Unlock your Mac
    • 2. Access password-protected files
    • 3. Password AutoFill with Touch ID
    • 4. Purchase items with Touch ID
    • 5. Switching users
    • 6. Authorizing system changes
  • Is Touch ID secure?

What is Touch ID on Mac?

Touch ID is a biometric authentication system developed by Apple. It actually is a fingerprint recognition feature built into the power button of selected Mac models and Magic Keyboard, designed to make your device more secure and easier to use.

It works through a small sensor, typically located on the keyboard, that scans your fingerprint and confirms your identity. Once set up, it lets you unlock your Mac, authorize purchases, and access sensitive information with just a touch of your finger. So, you no longer need to type in your password.

Touch ID is highly convenient but also really secure. It takes a high-resolution image of your fingerprint and turns it into a mathematical code. The code is later encrypted and stored only on your device in a secure place, never being shared with Apple or third parties. So, your personal information stays safe.

Now that you understand Touch ID, let’s check out how to set it up on a Mac.

How to set up Touch ID on Mac

Typically, when you set up a new Mac, it will ask you to create a Touch ID so that you can quickly unlock your Mac next time. However, if you have skipped the procedure back then or want to add a new fingerprint, follow the steps below.

  1. Click the Apple logo () → Select System Settings.

  2. Locate and choose Touch ID & Password → Click on Add Fingerprint.

  3. Enter your Mac’s password → Hit Unlock.

  4. Now, place your finger on the power button to scan it.
  5. Click Done to finish scanning and set up the fingerprint.

Using these steps, you can add up to three fingerprints to your user account. However, one Mac can save the maximum number of fingerprints only. Once you have set up Touch ID on your Mac, let’s see how to manage it.

How to rename or delete fingerprints on Mac

If your Mac has several fingerprints registered, it can be confusing. But worry not! Apple lets you rename the fingerprints for better organization or delete old ones you no longer use to maintain security. This enables you to quickly identify and deny access to anyone you’ve given permission to use your device earlier.

Here’s how you can rename or delete Touch ID fingerprints on your Mac:

Rename a fingerprint

  1. Go to Touch ID & Password menu in the System Settings.
  2. Click on the Fingerprint [name]. A text field will appear.
  3. Type a new name and hit the return key.

Delete a fingerprint

  1. In the Touch ID & Password settings, hover your cursor over the fingerprint [name] you wish to delete.
  2. Now, click on the X icon.

  3. Enter your Mac password and select Unlock.

  4. Finally, confirm your choice by clicking Delete.

What you can do with Touch ID on your Mac

Even though the Touch ID setup on your Mac is straightforward, there is still much to learn! It’s a versatile tool that simplifies and secures many everyday tasks.

Here’s a detailed look at how to use Touch ID on your Mac to get the most out of this feature:

Note To ensure all the features works, go to System Settings > Touch ID & Password and check if all the toggles under your fingerprint are enabled.

1. Unlock your Mac

The primary function of Touch ID is to unlock your device without entering your Mac’s password. To confirm your identity, place your finger on the Touch ID sensor. The device will authenticate you by comparing your current fingerprint to the data already stored.

However, one of its drawbacks is that after restarting your Mac, you will need to enter your password at least once.

2. Access password-protected files

Touch ID enables you to use biometric authentication instead of typing in your Mac login password to access password-protected items. For example, you can open locked notes in the Notes app, access the Passwords app, authenticate third-party apps like 1Password, and much more.

Moreover, you can unlock tabs in Private Browsing on Safari. Thus, it can be one of the most useful features for you if you’re someone who forgets your password frequently.

3. Password AutoFill with Touch ID

Apple has made it easier to access your saved passwords and passkeys in iCloud Keychain with Touch ID. Whenever you try to login to any app or website in Safari, your Mac will prompt you to scan your fingerprint. This will autofill your credentials from the Password app.

Thus, you don’t need to manually enter usernames and passwords, saving time and effort. Furthermore, Touch ID can autofill your credit card information when asked, streamlining your online shopping experience.

4. Purchase items with Touch ID

In addition to its security benefits, Touch ID can also be a useful tool for completing purchases through Apple Pay and Apple stores.

  • App Store, Apple Books, and iTunes: When you download an app or purchase media from iTunes or Book Store, you will be asked to enter your Apple ID password. In this instance, you can scan your fingerprint to approve the purchase.
  • Apple Pay: When shopping online on websites that support Apple Pay, you can use Touch ID to complete the payment securely. Just place your finger on the sensor when prompted, and the transaction is done.

By eliminating the need to enter a password, scanning your fingerprint can make the process quick and effortless.

5. Switching users

If you share your Mac with family members or colleagues, Touch ID makes switching between user accounts seamless. Each person can register their fingerprint and log into their account by quick Touch ID authentication.

To do so, select the user icon in the menu bar, choose a different user, and then place your finger on Touch ID. However, the user you wish to switch with must have previously logged into the Mac by entering their password.

Moreover, your Mac should have fast user switching enabled. For more details, read our detailed guide on how to switch between users on a Mac!

6. Authorizing system changes

macOS asks for a password when making administrative changes like installing software or changing several settings. Touch ID allows you to perform these functions simply by scanning your fingertip.

Is Touch ID secure?

Yes, Touch ID is highly regarded as a secure authentication method. It verifies your identity using biometric data to unlock your device. It also uses a secure enclave, a unique piece of hardware that stores your fingerprint information while keeping it isolated from the rest of your device’s data.

However, like any other security measure, Touch ID is not foolproof and can potentially be breached by hackers or attackers. Tell me in the comments section what you think about Apple’s Touch ID.

FAQs

Which Mac models support Touch ID?

You can use Touch ID with MacBook Air (2018 and later) and MacBook Pro (2016 and later).

Can I use Touch ID for other apps or services?

Yes, you can use Touch ID tools with other apps and services since some third-party apps and services support Touch ID for authentication.

How many fingerprints can I register in Touch ID on Mac?

You can register up to three fingerprints in one user account on your Mac, and the maximum number that can be stored on your Mac is five.

What should I do if Touch ID is not working on Mac?

The first step in troubleshooting a Touch ID issue is to ensure that your finger is clean and dry. If that doesn’t solve the case, you can look at our article on fixing Touch ID issues on Mac.

  • How to make desktop shortcuts on Mac

blockGraphs.question: Which Mac models support Touch ID?
blockGraphs.answer: You can use Touch ID with MacBook Air (2018 and later) and MacBook Pro (2016 and later).

blockGraphs.question: Can I use Touch ID for other apps or services?
blockGraphs.answer: Yes, you can use Touch ID tools with other apps and services since some third-party apps and services support Touch ID for authentication.

blockGraphs.question: How many fingerprints can I register in Touch ID on Mac?
blockGraphs.answer: You can register up to three fingerprints in one user account on your Mac, and the maximum number that can be stored on your Mac is five.

blockGraphs.question: What should I do if Touch ID is not working on Mac?
blockGraphs.answer: The first step in troubleshooting a Touch ID issue is to ensure that your finger is clean and dry. If that doesn't solve the case, you can look at our article on fixing Touch ID issues on Mac.

title.rendered: How to change Dictation language on Apple Watch

content.rendered:
You can use the Dictation feature on your Apple Watch to input text without going through the hassle of typing on its tiny screen. However, by default, you can dictate text only in the language your Apple Watch is set to. If you want to use another language, you must change the Dictation language. Keep reading, and I will show you how to change the Dictation language on an Apple Watch.

Table of Contents
  • How to change your Apple Watch Dictation language
  • Adjusting language settings on iPhone for Apple Watch
  • What languages does Apple Watch's Dictation feature support?
  • Why is Dictation not working on my Apple Watch?

How to change your Apple Watch Dictation language

Changing the Dictation language on your Apple Watch is straightforward. This is what you need to do:

  1. Open the app you want to dictate text in. I am using the Messages app for demonstration.
  2. Tap on an empty area on the text field to bring up the keyboard.
  3. When the keyboard appears, tap the keyboard icon in the bottom-right corner. Then, tap the mic icon to switch to Dictation mode. (In some Apple Watches, you will find the mic icon directly instead of the keyboard icon.)

  4. You can now swipe up from the bottom to show all the languages you had set on your Apple Watch.
  5. Finally, tap the language you want to dictate text in.

The best part about using Dictation on an Apple Watch is that changing the language is limited to that specific app and will not change your default Dictation language in any other app.

Adjusting language settings on iPhone for Apple Watch

If your preferred language is not available, you can follow the steps below to add a new language for Dictation on your Apple Watch. You can do this through your Apple Watch-connected iPhone using the following steps:

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap General, then scroll down and tap Keyboard.

  3. Tap Keyboards and select Add New Keyboard on the following screen.

  4. Now, tap the language you want to add.
  5. Select the type of keyboard and tap Done.

Now, when you return to your Apple Watch, you will see that the new language has been added. You can dictate text in it on your Watch.

What languages does Apple Watch’s Dictation feature support?

Did you not find the language you are looking for? Check if that language is a part of the list of languages supported by Dictation below:

Arabic (Kuwait), Arabic (Qatar), Arabic (Saudi Arabia), Arabic (United Arab Emirates), Cantonese (China mainland), Cantonese (Hong Kong), Catalan , Croatian, Czech Danish, Dutch (Belgium), Dutch (Netherlands), English (Australia), English (Canada), English (India), English (Ireland), English (Malaysia), English (New Zealand), English (Philippines), English (Saudi Arabia), English (Singapore), English (South Africa), English (United Arab Emirates), English (United Kingdom), English (United States), Finnish, French (Belgium), French (Canada), French (France), French (Luxembourg), French (Switzerland), German (Austria), German (Germany), German (Switzerland), Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian (Italy), Italian (Switzerland), Japanese, Korean, Malay, Mandarin Chinese (China mainland), Mandarin Chinese (Taiwan), Norwegian (Bokmål), Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Romanian, Russian, Shanghainese (China Mainland), Slovak, Spanish (Latin America), Spanish (Mexico), Spanish (Spain), Spanish (United States), Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.

Why is Dictation not working on my Apple Watch?

Sometimes, the Dictation feature may not work on your Apple Watch. This could happen due to various reasons, but you can try the following solutions to fix it.

  • Enable Dictation: Firstly, ensure that the Dictation feature is turned on your Apple Watch. To do this, open Settings and go to General → Dictation. Then, toggle on the switch next to Dictation.
  • Restart your device: If the feature is enabled but you still can’t use it, try restarting your Apple Watch and iPhone. Sometimes, a simple restart can fix glitches in the UI.
  • Update software: If the issue persists, check if your Apple Watch and iPhone are updated to the latest software. If not, update them right away. Software updates often fix bugs and issues.
  • Contact Apple Support: When nothing helps, the last resort is to contact Apple Support for help.

Signing off

Dictation can save you a lot of your time, especially if you frequently reply to messages and emails or take notes, directly on your Apple Watch. With Apple supporting a good number of languages for Dictation and seeing how simple it is to switch between them, you can easily use the language of your choice in an app when you need it.

FAQs

Does the Dictation language sync with my iPhone?

Yes, your iPhone keyboard language is set as Dictation language on your Apple Watch.

Will changing the Dictation language affect apps on Apple Watch?

No, changing the Dictation language is specific to that particular app and will not affect other apps on your device.

Also read:

  • How to take a screenshot on Apple Watch
  • How to install and delete apps on Apple Watch
  • Is your Apple Watch not charging? Here’s what to do

mainEntity.name: Which Mac models support Touch ID?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can use Touch ID with MacBook Air (2018 and later) and MacBook Pro (2016 and later).

mainEntity.name: Can I use Touch ID for other apps or services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can use Touch ID tools with other apps and services since some third-party apps and services support Touch ID for authentication.

mainEntity.name: How many fingerprints can I register in Touch ID on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can register up to three fingerprints in one user account on your Mac, and the maximum number that can be stored on your Mac is five.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if Touch ID is not working on Mac?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first step in troubleshooting a Touch ID issue is to ensure that your finger is clean and dry. If that doesn't solve the case, you can look at our article on fixing Touch ID issues on Mac.

title.rendered: Best places to buy refurbished iPhones in 2026

content.rendered:
With a new iPhone series launching every year, you’re probably tempted to upgrade to the latest model. However, the cost of a brand-new smartphone may not fit in your budget. This is where refurbished iPhones come into play; they’re functional and affordable. Not sure where to start looking for trustworthy sources? We’ve researched the best places to buy a refurbished iPhone and put them together in this list.

Table of Contents
  • Things to consider when buying a refurbished iPhone
  • Best places to buy a refurbished or second-hand iPhone
    • 1. Apple Refurbished Store
    • 2. Gazelle
    • 3. Amazon Renewed
    • 4. Back Market
    • 5. Best Buy
    • 6. OzMobiles
    • 7. decluttr
    • 8. eBay
    • 9. Swappa
    • 10. RefurbMe
    • Bonus: Buy from respective carriers
  • Difference between used and refurbished iPhones

Things to consider when buying a refurbished iPhone

Refurbished iPhones are not faulty devices. They have been checked and certified by technicians to ensure they’re working properly. The previous owner might have returned the iPhone due to minor defects, cosmetic issues like dents and scratches, or simply because they wanted an upgrade.

However, consider the following to ensure a safe purchase.

  • Source: Purchase from reputable sellers such as Apple’s official refurbished store or well-known retailers. Read reviews from other buyers who have purchased refurbished devices from the same source. 
  • Warranty: Ensure the device comes with a warranty. This way you can get proper assistance in case any issues arise. 
  • Certification: Look for a certification of quality to ensure proper working conditions.  
  • Return policy: Check the seller’s return policy if the device doesn’t meet your expectations. 
  • Authenticity: Verify it’s not a stolen or counterfeit product. 
  • Cosmetic condition: Check the cosmetic imperfections and ensure they don’t affect the performance. 
  • Battery life: It’s wise to get a refurbished iPhone that can recharge at least 80% to 90% of its maximum battery life. 
  • Compatibility: Check the device’s compatibility with your carrier.
  • Future considerations: Consider the long-term needs like future software support and compatibility with upcoming technologies. 

While refurbished iPhones can be a great value, there’s always some inherent risk. Conduct thorough research and purchase from reliable sources to minimize that risk.

Read our detailed guide to know the prerequisites to buying a second-hand iPhone.

Best places to buy a refurbished or second-hand iPhone

Instead of buying a new iPhone, consider purchasing a refurbished one. The following are some of the best places to do so!

1. Apple Refurbished Store 

It’s tough to think of a better place to buy a used iPhone than Apple’s official Refurbished Store. Apple experts thoroughly inspect and repair second-hand iPhones to meet quality standards. The best part is you will receive your refurbished iPhone in new Apple-branded packaging, with a new battery, and a clean exterior shell.

Apple also offers a one-year limited warranty and the option to add another year of AppleCare coverage. Additionally, you will get free next-day shipping and a 14-day return period.

However, premium quality comes with a hefty price tag. This store’s pricing is more significant than all other refurbished iPhone sites. You’re still getting an iPhone at a sizable price cut, but you do have more affordable options elsewhere.

Check out on: Apple Refurbished Store

2. Gazelle

Gazelle is the most reputable third-party platform for buying refurbished iPhones at a meager price. They buy smartphones from individuals, repair them through a 30-point inspection program, and sell them after quality assurance.

Many refurbished iPhones are available in various colors, carriers, and sizes. You will also get free shipping and monthly payment modes. But remember, it only offers a return policy of 30 days. You can also sell your used iPhones and other Apple devices at a reasonable price.

Check out on: Gazelle

3. Amazon Renewed 

Amazon Renewed is a flourishing site for buying refurbished phones at exclusive prices. They also include accessories with every refurbished iPhone box. You’ll bag a 90-day Amazon Renewed Guarantee and return policy with your purchase as well.

Moreover, most iPhones qualify for Prime delivery. Fast, affordable, high-quality refurbished iPhones—what’s not to love?

Check out on: Amazon Renewed

4. Back Market

Back Market lets you buy refurbished iPhones at various conditions (Excellent, Good, and Fair) to fit your budget. It also provides an expert checking certification, a 1-year warranty, a free 30-day return policy, and monthly installment plans.

Refurbished iPhone sellers on the Back Market must pass a stringent screening procedure and satisfy its quality standards. If the iPhone battery has under 500 cycles and less than 80% of its original capacity, it must be replaced.

Check out on: Back Market

5. Best Buy 

Best Buy is a renowned and trusted seller of open-box, unlocked, and pre-owned iPhones. It offers used iPhones in solid conditions with freebies and a whopping discount. You will get 3 months of Apple TV+, 4 months of Apple Music, and 4 months of Apple News+ subscriptions for free with your purchase.

You can also choose between free shipping or quick pickup for added convenience. It provides a warranty (limited 90 days) on recently-purchased products as well, which makes Best Buy one of the best places to buy a refurbished iPhone.

Check out on: Best Buy

6. OzMobiles

OzMobiles store has a wide range of inexpensive refurbished iPhones and other gadgets. They buy used iPhones locally and restore them to their full working potential through a Blancco-certified 72-point quality testing process.

OzMobiles offers a Battery Life Guarantee and ensures every refurbished iPhone has at least 80% battery capacity, too. So, you don’t have to be concerned about the battery condition of your refurbished iPhones.

Additionally, you will get a free 12-month warranty and a 30-day risk-free return policy.

Check out on: OzMobiles

7. eBay 

eBay offers a massive catalog of refurbished iPhones to buy at impressive discounts. It basically acts as a marketplace for second-hand iPhone dealers.

However, eBay doesn’t provide any product quality assurance or warranty. It’s important to check product ratings and seller reviews before finalizing a purchase. In short: make sure you know what you’re buying.

You can always message the seller directly with any questions or concerns you may have. Take note of whether the listing offers a refund policy, as this is determined by the seller.

Check out on: eBay

8. Swappa

Swappa offers an extensive collection of used and refurbished iPhones with various discounts. But you must shop carefully to grab the best deal.

It also provides PayPal purchase protection for buyers to avoid fraud. The best part: you’ll get detailed product guides and built-in comparisons to help you choose the right one.

Check out on: Swappa

9. RefurbMe

RefurbMe is a marketplace where you can see all the trusted and certified refurbished iPhone sellers in one place. So, you can compare prices and get up to 75% savings.

RefurbMe ensures all the vendors offer a warranty and hassle-free return policy. Therefore, you don’t need to do extensive research. RefurbMe’s ease of use and helpful price compiling lands it a spot in the best places to buy a refurbished iPhone.

Check out on: RefurbMe

Bonus: Buy from respective carriers

Many well-known carrier providers like Sprint, T-Mobile, Verizon, and AT&T sell certified pre-owned iPhones with hefty discounts. Give them a look and you might find quite the deal!

But note that you will only get carrier-locked iPhones. Therefore, take a close look at the “conditions” before purchasing.

Difference between used and refurbished iPhones

While buying second-hand iPhones, you may see different labels, like “refurbished” or “pre-owned.” So, it’s crucial to differentiate between used and refurbished iPhones to make an informed decision. The table below outlines the key distinctions:

title.rendered: How to delete Instagram account on iPhone (or deactivate it)

content.rendered:
The social media era has ingrained platforms like Instagram into our lives. But there may come a time when you feel the need to take a break or say goodbye to the platform. If you, too, are looking for ways to step down from Instagram, then this guide is for you.

In this article, I’ll take you through the step-by-step process of deleting or deactivating your Instagram account on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • How to delete Instagram account on iPhone (permanently)
  • How to deactivate Instagram account on iPhone

How to delete Instagram account on iPhone (permanently)

For one reason or another, you’ve decided to delete your Instagram account. You’ll need to do so manually, either on your phone or computer. However, be aware that deleting your account permanently removes your photos and videos. I’ve included a step-by-step tutorial on downloading your IG data at the bottom of this section.

Here’s how to delete your Instagram account:

  1. Access Instagram on your iPhone.
  2. Navigate to your profile → Tap the hamburger icon → Select the Settings option.
  3. Choose See more in Accounts Center to proceed → Select Personal details under Account settings.
  4. Tap Account ownership and control → Hit Deactivation and deletion.

  5. Opt for your account when prompted.
  6. Choose the Delete account option → Hit Continue to proceed.
  7. Select a reason that justifies your case → Tap Continue.

  8. Hit Continue.
  9. Enter your account password → Select Continue.
  10. Finally, tap Delete account to conclude the process.

Note: You’ll be notified of the date when your account will cease to exist. Until then, if you change your mind, re-access your account to terminate the process. There will be no return once the respective date has passed.

Because deleting your account permanently removes all photos, videos, and comments you’ve posted, you may wish to download a copy of your IG data before going through with account deletion.

Here’s how:

  1. Head to your profile → Tap the hamburger icon → Select Settings.
  2. Just as before, tap See more in Accounts Center. Now choose Your information and permissions.
  3. Tap Download your information → Download or transfer information.
  4. If you have multiple Instagram profiles linked to your Accounts Center, choose the profile you’d like the information from. Then, tap Next.
  5. Select whether you’d like to download All available information or Some of your information (which allows you to choose what you’d like to save before deleting your account).
  6. Then, choose whether you want to download the information to your device directly or transfer it to another location, such as Google Drive.
  7. Once you’ve decided, tap Next. Then, enter the Date range from which you wish to download your data. Fill out the remaining options, such as Format and Media quality. Tap Create Files to begin downloading your information.

If you’d rather just take a break from Instagram than permanently delete your account, follow the steps below.

How to deactivate Instagram account on iPhone

A break from social media could act as a healing period for individuals. However, achieving this peace does not require extreme solutions like deleting your Instagram account. You could rather deactivate your account for a set amount of time.

  1. Follow steps 1-6 as discussed above.
  2. Choose Deactivate account → Hit Continue.
  3. Enter your account’s credentials and tap Continue to move ahead.
  4. Pick a reason → Hit Continue.

  5. Tap Deactivate account to conclude the process.

Note: Your Instagram account will stay hidden from the platform until you log back in again.

Be more than an Instagrammer!

Now that you’ve successfully got the gist of deleting or deactivating your Instagram account, you can curate a mindful experience for yourself. With a clearer mind and a sense of liberation, you can redirect your energy and focus on things that truly matter.

Thank you for reading. If any, take a moment to comment on your queries or concerns, and I’ll be at your service.

FAQs

Why does it take 1 month to delete the Instagram account? 

The one-month period to permanently delete your Instagram account is to protect your account data if you have a second thought. Once you delete it, you can’t get your account back.

Can I get my Instagram account back after deleting it? 

Yes. But you have to log in within one month after deleting your account. After that period, you won’t be able to retrieve it.

Can I reactivate my Instagram account after 1 year? 

Yes. If you have deactivated your account, you can retrieve it anytime. But if you have deleted your account and tried to log in after a month, you won’t be able to access it.

  • Why does Instagram keep saying “Something went wrong” and how to fix it?
