title.rendered: Best AirTag alternatives in 2026

content.rendered:
The Apple AirTag has ultra-wideband technology for seamless communication with other Apple devices. But one drawback of the AirTag is its limited compatibility with older iOS versions and Android devices. 

If you use devices other than Apple or an older iOS version and want alternatives to AirTag, look no further! We’ll guide you through some of the best AirTag alternatives.

Table of Contents
  • 1. The PebblebeeClip – Editor’s Choice
  • 2. The Chipolo ONE Spot – Loud and useful
  • 3. The Samsung Galaxy SmartTag+ – 120m Bluetooth range
  • 4. The Tile Bluetooth Tracker – Multiple models
  • 5. The ATUVOS Key Finder – Built-in NFC
  • Things to consider when exploring AirTag alternatives

1. The PebblebeeClip – Editor’s Choice

If you need a tracker with an impressive range, the Pebblebee Clip is your go-to choice. Its 500 ft Bluetooth range sets it apart from the competition, making it an outstanding option. It seamlessly integrates with Apple Find My, allowing it to leverage the extensive Find My network and locate items even when they are further away. What’s more? It also works perfectly with Android devices.

The Pebblebee Clip has a rechargeable battery with an impressive lifespan of up to 6 months on a single charge. It seamlessly integrates with popular smart home assistants such as Amazon’s Alexa, Google Assistant, and Siri, allowing you to locate your items effortlessly.

Featuring a sleek design and a stainless steel keychain attachment, the Pebblebee Clip combines both style and functionality. The bright LED lights enhance its visibility, making it easy to locate even in the dark.

Additionally, it emits a loud ring sound of about 90dB, ensuring that you can easily find your belongings. Although it can handle everyday splashes and spills, be cautious when close to water.

Pros

  • It features an LED emission for night search
  • Works with both iOS and Android devices
  • It uses a long-lasting rechargeable battery
  • Integrates with popular smart home assistants

Cons

  • The associated app can occasionally be tardy

Check out on Amazon

2. The Chipolo ONE Spot – Loud and useful

The Chipolo One Spot is another innovative Bluetooth finder that seamlessly integrates with the Apple Find My network on iOS devices, with compatibility for Android devices. Moreover, it has a Bluetooth range of up to 200ft.

To set up the Chipolo One Spot on your Apple device, add it to the items tab in the Find My app. Considering the vast Apple Find My network of millions of Apple devices worldwide, locating your missing belongings becomes easier. By activating the Lost Mode feature, Chipolo ONE Spot will display a customized message with your contact information to anyone who finds it.

Featuring a keyring hole, the Chipolo ONE Spot allows you to attach your keys directly. Its 120dB loud sound ensures you locate your belongings even in noisy or distant environments. Moreover, its water-resistant design guarantees worry-free usage. However, to unlock the full potential of the Chipolo ONE Spot and use the Find My app’s features, we recommend using the latest version of OS on your Apple device.

Pros

  • Broad compatibility with iOS and Android devices
  • Water-resistant 
  • The 120dB ring volume is fairly loud
  • Integrates easily with Apple Find My

Cons

  • It has a thinner tracking network on the Android
  • No ultra-wideband tracking

Check out on Amazon

3. The Samsung Galaxy SmartTag+ – 120m Bluetooth range

The Galaxy SmartTag+ works perfectly with the Samsung ecosystem. It bonds excellently with the Galaxy Find Network, allowing you to track the SmartTag with every compatible Samsung phone nearby. The Galaxy SmartTags effortlessly track misplaced items within a remarkable range of about 390 feet, even when you’re offline.

Its single tap-to-find feature and the bonded app (SmartThings) enable you to control various Samsung smart products in your home. For example, you can turn on your lights by tapping the SmartTag button. In addition to requiring a Samsung account, pairing it with an ultra-wideband (UWB) enabled Galaxy smartphone running Android 11 or higher guarantees optimal functionality.

That said, the simple design and small size make it very handy. It also has a hollow for can attaching your keys. Its battery is a replaceable CR2032 lithium coin cell. This has an average lifespan of up to four years. You can get the battery over the counter should it drain out.

Pros

  • Water-resistant
  • The ultrawideband technology in SmartTag+ enhances precise tracking
  • Long-lasting and replaceable battery
  • It supports smart home integration

Cons

  • A bit more expensive than the AirTag

Check out on Amazon

4. The Tile Bluetooth Tracker – Multiple models

Tile is arguably one of the best alternatives to the AirTag. Whether you’re an iPhone or Android user, Tile has you covered. It works seamlessly with popular smart home assistants like Amazon’s Alexa, Google Assistant, and Siri, allowing you to locate your items effortlessly.

You can install the free Tile app, which allows you to locate your Tile within Bluetooth range. If you misplace your Tile outside of Bluetooth range, the app will let you view your Tile’s most recent location on a map. Additionally, the Tile Network enables other users to assist you in finding your lost items. With an IP67 water-resistant rating, it can handle exposure to water without affecting its functioning.

Tile features different models, including Tile Mate, Pro, Slim, and Sticker, which come in different shapes and sizes. Each model has unique features and is adapted to suit different needs. Although you can use its Tile app for free, Tile Premium offers additional features.

Pros

  • Broad compatibility with iOS and Android devices
  • Water-resistant 
  • Wide range and loud ring volume
  • Incredibly durable and Sleek design

Cons

  • Subscription required for advanced features
  • No ultra-wideband tracking

Check out on Amazon

5. The ATUVOS Key Finder – Built-in NFC

Looking for a more affordable alternative to the AirTag? Look no further than the ATUVOS Key Finder. It is stylish and features a hollow ring design, allowing you to attach your keys easily. Offering similar functionality to the AirTag, it seamlessly connects to the Find My app on your Apple device. Mark an item as lost. The network will help you locate it.

One unique feature of the ATUVOS Key Finder is its built-in NFC function. By adding your contact information, anyone who finds your lost tag can access your details and contact you promptly. Additionally, scanning the NFC tag will automatically update the last-found real-time location.

Durability is a priority with the ATUVOS Key Finder, as it boasts an IP67 waterproof rating, ensuring its resilience in various conditions. You can quickly locate your items within the range with a Bluetooth range of up to 400 feet and a beeping sound ring of 80 dB. With a battery lifespan of up to a year, you can enjoy long-lasting performance before needing a replacement. Plus, the key finder will notify you when the battery needs replacement.

Pros

  • Affordable
  • Built-in NFC function makes it easy to contact the item owner
  • Super-wide range of up to 400 ft

Cons

  • The 80dB volume might make lost items difficult to find in noisy areas

Check out on Amazon

Things to consider when exploring AirTag alternatives

  • Compatibility: Ensure the device is suitable and works well with your smartphone or device.
  • Design: Another thing to consider is the tracker’s size, shape, and design. You’ll need to look for a form factor that suits your needs.
  • Range: How far a device can effectively track your belongings is worth considering. You may want to evaluate the range capabilities of the tracker as to whether it is suitable for your intended use.
  • Tracking ecosystem: The size of the tracking ecosystem determines how effective the tracker will be. You may want to check if the tracker provides a user-friendly app or platform that lets you easily track your items, set up alerts, and manage multiple devices simultaneously.
  • Waterproofing: Considering the waterproofing capabilities of the tracker is essential. If you intend to track objects or pets exposed to water or moisture, a tracker with a high water resistance rating is what you want.
  • Battery: It is essential to consider the battery life of the tracker. Choosing a tracker with long-lasting battery performance guarantees you can track your belongings without worrying about frequent battery replacements.
  • Pricing: Generally, Bluetooth trackers are often affordable. However, buying them in sets can save you some money. Also, you may want to assess each option’s features, performance, and value for money to make a decision that aligns with your budget.

Never get lost!

In today’s fast-paced world, losing track of our belongings has become a very common occurrence. However, thanks to various AirTag alternatives, you can now choose from the options available to suit your needs. Searching for lost or stolen items has become more convenient than ever. These cutting-edge devices have quickly gained popularity and emerged as trusted companions for users seeking ultimate convenience in tracking their valuable possessions.

  • Clever ways to use Apple AirTags

title.rendered: Best iPad Car Chargers in 2026

content.rendered:
Having an iPad car charger makes it easier to handle the power needs of your iPad. If you use the tablet extensively, you’re most likely running into low battery alerts on it. If you’ve got a car charger lying around, you can charge your iPad on the go and keep it ready for use at all times. These are the best iPad car chargers based on the ability to charge an iPad at top speed. They provide the complete safeguard from short circuits and over/low voltage. Fireproof material, the car chargers are very efficient and secure. Let’s get to know more about the top car chargers for iPad!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen
  • 2. Gembonics
  • 3. Anker PowerDrive 2
  • 4. AmazonBasics
  • 5. Ailun
  • 6. Andobil

1. Spigen

Spigen is more popular for producing affordable cases for smartphones including Apple iPhones . So, I guess many of you might be a little surprised to see this accessory maker in this roundup.

The car charger looks highly effective with the ability to deliver 30W total output. Aside from supporting iPad, it also works quite well Android devices Galaxy, Pixel, OnePlus, and more. With the inclusion of Smart IC chip, Spigen car charger also makes sure your devices have got the safeguard against unexpected dangers like overheating and overcurrent.

USP: Smart IC chip
Check out on Amazon

2. Gembonics

Made of high-quality fireproof material, Gembonics car charger provides complete safety. The charger comes with an original Apple lightning connector and authentication chip that makes it fully compatible to charge and sync with iOS devices.

The high output of 3.1 Amps helps it charge your device with lightning-fast speed. Whenever there is overcharging, over/lower voltage, charging stops automatically to protect your device. The portable design allows you to carry it comfortably.

USP: Ultra-portable design
Check out on Amazon

3. Anker PowerDrive 2

Anker PowerDrive 2 comes with PowerIQ Technology that empowers it to charge your device at a rapid speed. The ability to offer charge speed up to 2.4 amps per port or 4.8 amps overall makes it very handy.

The high output of 24 watts through two ports allows you to power up two devices at once. MultiProtect safety system ensures your iOS device has complete safety from short-circuiting, overcharging and overcurrent.

The compact and lightweight design makes it ultra-portable. Beyond portability, PowerDrive 2 comes with the 18-month warranty.

USP: MultiProtect safety system
Check out on Amazon

4. AmazonBasics

AmazonBasics car charger offers you all the comfort you would want to power up your device with needed safety and speed. With the Apple MFi certification, it’s fully compatible to let you charge and sync your iPad.

It charges your device through the car’s DC adapter. With four advanced USB ports available, you will be able to juice up four devices at once. The car charger delivers 2.4A output, which is up to the mark for charging your iOS device at a rapid speed.

The charger provides the necessary security from common threats like short-circuiting and also allows you to use your device while it’s being powered up. You have three colors to choose from: black, white and black/red. Lastly, AmazonBasics comes with a one-year limited warranty. Note: AmazonBasics with two USB ports is priced at $7.64.

USP: CE, FCC, and RoHS certified
Check out on Amazon

5. Ailun

Ailun has been in the car charging game for long. And more importantly, it’s known to produce compact and secure car chargers. Talking about this offering, it seems to be a complete asset with all the essential features.

Be it fast charging or safeguard against short-circuiting and over-voltage, it has checked off all the basics. Even on the durability aspect, Ailun car charger looks strong enough to take on some beating. Apart from charging iPad and iPad, it also powers up Android devices a lot faster thanks to the Qualcomm Quick Charge 3.0 technology.

USP: Automatically adjusts to optimal voltage for safe charging
Check out on Amazon

6. Andobil

Here’s a car charger that employs a unique “Dual Independent Chip” for fast charging with 20W power delivery. It can power up your iPad and another device simultaneously. It also passes the necessary FCC certificates to protect your device from short-circuit, over-temperature, over-voltage.

Further, it’s designed to be more compact, so you can drive on bumpy roads while still charging continuously without interruption. This makes it perfect for travel. I also appreciate the rugged build that will last you over time.

USP: Compact yet durable
Check out on Amazon

Signing Off!

Now, use these top chargers to juice up your iOS devices with optimum convenience even on the drive. With the necessary protection from excessive current or short circuits, they ensure your iPad has complete safety while charging. Is any of your favorite charger missing from this list? I would like to know its name.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best essential tools for cleaning your Apple products in 2026

content.rendered:
We understand the importance of keeping your gadgets pristine, from iPhones to MacBooks. In this article, I’ll share the must-have cleaning products to maintain your devices’ visual appeal and optimal performance. So, whether you’re a tech-savvy professional, a student, or an Apple aficionado, discover the essential cleaning tools kit for your Apple products that will revolutionize your routine.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple Polish cloth – Premium microfibre towel
  • 2. Amazon Basics microfibre cleaning cloths – Complete bundle
  • 3. EVEO screen cleaner spray – Get free microfibre wipes
  • 4. Mom Store screen cleaner kit – Value for money
  • 5. Clorox disinfecting wipes – Maintain hygiene
  • 6. Pharma-C 70% Isopropyl Alcohol Wipes – Free from bacteria
  • 7. Ci Kyan cleaning swabs – Keep ducts clean
  • 8. Tassmpitor port cleaning kit – No more rust
  • 9. Tassmpitor screen keyboard cleaner kit – One for all Apple products
  • 10. UPPERCASE GhostCover Keyboard protector – Keep dust away
  • Guidelines to clean your Apple products

1. Apple Polish cloth – Premium microfibre towel

What could be better than an official microfiber cloth from Apple’s house for your iPhone, iPad, MacBook, and other devices? Though the price tag of $20 is a bit expensive, it’s worth it for the premium, soft, and non-abrasive material.

Moreover, it’s the most crucial product in my cleaning kit to clean all Apple displays, including nano-texture ones, securely and efficiently for dust, dirt, and stain removal.

Check out on: Amazon

2. Amazon Basics microfibre cleaning cloths – Complete bundle

The Amazon Basics microfiber cleaning cloths come in a pack of 24, which is more than enough for all your devices. The clothes are made of high-quality, ultra-soft, and non-abrasive microfiber polyester material. So, the displays will not be scratched. Besides, I have used these clothes to clean different surfaces in my home, including windows, mirrors, countertops, and appliances.  

It picked up dirt and dust quickly and left behind a streak-free finish. The best part is that these clothes are reusable. I can simply throw them in the washing machine after each use. This saves me money on paper towels and other disposable cleaning supplies. But after a few uses, it becomes linty.

Check out on: Amazon

3. EVEO screen cleaner spray – Get free microfibre wipes

The Eveo screen cleaner spray and microfiber cloth are essential for cleaning iPhone, iPad, Mac, and other Apple products. It’s the perfect way to clean screens and remove dirt, dust, smudge, and fingerprints.

The cleaning solution spray is non-abrasive and safe for all surfers, and the plush microfiber cloth is soft and absorbent. So, it efficiently removes tough stains and leaves no streaks, discoloration, or fiber shedding. For its detailed usage, refer to our guide on how to clean your MacBook screen.

Check out on: Amazon

4. Mom Store screen cleaner kit – Value for money

Rather than buying cleaning products individually, Mom Store bundles everything in one pack. The alcohol-free odorless cleaning solution keeps your screens clean and free of fingerprints, dust, and smudges.

Besides, the microfiber cloth is non-abrasive, soft, and lint-free and helps to remove all traces of dirt and grime. I even use it as my keyboard cleaner as well to keep hygiene. One bottle lasts for 1500 sprays on average, so you don’t have to worry for a long time.  

Check out on: Amazon

5. Clorox disinfecting wipes – Maintain hygiene

Besides screen and keyboard hygiene, you must take care of the exterior of your devices, especially MacBook and AirPods. That’s why I use Clorox disinfecting wipes to clean the device surfaces, protective cases, accessories, and other tools in my cleaning kit for Apple products.

The triple-layer wipes are robust and effective at killing 99.9% of viruses and bacteria. I like that they are bleach-free and have a fresh lime scent. If you are looking for an affordable cleaning tool, then I’d highly recommend getting this product.

Check out on: Amazon

6. Pharma-C 70% Isopropyl Alcohol Wipes – Free from bacteria

Pharma cleaning wipes are vital in my cleaning kit for my MacBook. They are pre-moistened with 70% Isopropyl Alcohol, the recommended concentration for cleaning Apple products. Besides, the sheets are also soft, pliable, and low-lint and guarantee not to scratch the surface of your MacBook.

Don’t worry about storing the wet alcohol wipes. It is packaged in a pop-top canister with an easy-dispensing lid and a safety seal, preventing the wipes from drying. 

Check out on: Amazon

7. Ci Kyan cleaning swabs – Keep ducts clean

You must also take care of the ports on your Apple products, not only the display, keyboard, and exterior. And these foam swabs are great for cleaning dust, lint, and other particles in tight spaces. It’s long nozzle and pointed tip allow you to reach hard-to-reach areas. I have this in my AirPods cleaning kit always.  

Check out on: Amazon

8. Tassmpitor port cleaning kit – No more rust

Till now, I have focused on MacBook care, and now it’s time for a cleaning kit for iPhone. The Lightning Port Cleaning Tool is a small but effective cleaning product to keep your iPhone’s port new. It is made of durable plastic and has a small, pointed tip is perfect for removing dirt, lint, and other debris.

Besides, you will get several brushes, a cleaning solution, and a microfibre cloth for effective cleaning. Finally, you may go through our complete guide to learn how to clean iPhone speakers and microphones.

Check out on: Amazon

9. Tassmpitor screen keyboard cleaner kit – One for all Apple products

This Electronics cleaning kit is the ultimate accessory for MacBook and iPhone cleaning. You will get 10 tools in one bundle, including different brushes, lens cleaner, polishing cloth, metal tip pen, flocking sponge, cleaning spray, etc. So, you can keep all your gadgets clean and free of dust and debris. The best thing is the kit is so compact that I can carry it everywhere. 

Check out on: Amazon

10. UPPERCASE GhostCover Keyboard protector – Keep dust away

I know cleaning Mac’s keyboard is tiresome yet essential. That’s why I use a Keyboard cover. It’s 12mm thick and made from durable TPU material. As there’s no silicon used, it will not stretch with time. So, your MacBook keyboard will be safe from spills, dust, and other pollutants.  

The thin transparent design allows your keyboard’s backlight and brightness to show through. After using it for some time, you may machine wash and reuse it.  

Check out on: Amazon

Guidelines to clean your Apple products

Besides having the essential cleaning kit, you must know the proper guidelines for using those. Here, I will share some cleaning tips to keep in mind for different Apple products: 

iPhone, iPad, and MacBook: 

  • Before cleaning, power off your device and unplug any cables. 
  • Use a soft, lint-free cloth to gently wipe the screen and exterior surfaces. 
  • Avoid using abrasive materials or cleaners that may damage the screen or coatings. 
  • For stubborn smudges or fingerprints, dampen the cloth with water and wipe gently with no slight pressure. 
  • Don’t spray liquids directly on the device; apply them to the cloth instead. 
  • Avoid getting moisture in the charging ports or other openings. 

If you want similar tips for Apple Watch, refer to our guide on how to clean your Apple Watch and how to clean Apple Watch bands.  

Keep your gadgets pristine!

These essential cleaning kit tools let you safeguard your Apple products’ longevity, performance, and visual appeal. Besides, regular maintenance of ports and headphone jacks is crucial in preventing dust buildup. By prioritizing proper care, you’ll extend the lifespan and ensure the gadgets continue to be productive for years. 

Explore more…

  • Best accessories for MacBook Air M2 and M1 
  • Best accessories for iPhone 14 series
  • How to clean your MacBook screen
  • iPhone repair kits: What they include and how to choose the right one

mainEntity.name: What is Apple Music authorization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Music authorization connects your Mac or any device to your Apple Account, so you can access your purchased music and synced libraries. It’s particularly useful when you’re subscribed to Apple Music and have purchased content, which you don’t want to be accessible for everyone with access to your Apple Account-linked device.

mainEntity.name: Why is my Mac not authorized to play music?

acceptedAnswer.text: This might be because you haven’t authorized your Mac yet, or you’ve hit the limit of five authorized devices. You can reset the limit by deauthorizing devices you don't need by hitting the Deauthorize All button under Account > Account Settings > Computer Authorizations.

mainEntity.name: Does deauthorizing my Mac delete my music or playlists?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, deauthorizing only revokes access to your Apple ID on that Mac. Your music and playlists will still be safe in your account and on other authorized devices.

title.rendered: What is Reachability on iPhone and how to use it

content.rendered:
Navigating your iPhone’s huge screen with one hand can be tricky, especially when trying to reach the top. That’s where Reachability comes in! This feature makes it easier to access the top portion of the screen without awkward finger stretches. So, you can check notifications and operate your iPhone single-handedly. Let’s explore how to enable and use Reachability on iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • What is the use of Reachability on iPhone?
  • How to turn on or off Reachability on iPhone
  • How to use Reachability to navigate iPhone with one hand

What is the use of Reachability on iPhone?

Reachability is an accessibility feature designed to make iPhones with larger displays easier to use. It shifts down the top half of the screen so your thumb can reach icons, buttons, and menus that would otherwise require two hands. This is particularly useful when:

  • Accessing apps and icons at the top of the Home Screen.
  • Using the Control Center or Notification Center without adjusting your grip.
  • Reaching buttons or search bars at the top of apps.

I use the feature often when working as I find it difficult to navigate the big iPhone 15 Pro Max screen with my small hands. By making the screen content more accessible, Reachability enhances the overall user experience and reduces hand strain.

How to turn on or off Reachability on iPhone

Before you can use Reachability, you need to ensure the feature is enabled in your iPhone settings. Here’s how you can do so:

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Scroll down and tap Accessibility.
  3. Under the Physical and Motor section, select Touch.
  4. Toggle on Reachability.

Once activated, you can use Reachability with a simple gesture.

However, the feature may be accidentally activated when scrolling through your iPhone. So, if you find it unhelpful, you can disable Reachability using the same steps on your iPhone.

How to use Reachability to navigate iPhone with one hand

Once Reachability is enabled, you can easily activate it and minimize your iPhone screen.

  • For iPhones with Face ID (iPhone X and later): Swipe downward on the bottom edge of the screen (just above the Home bar).

  • For iPhones with Touch ID: Quickly double tap the Home button lightly (don’t press it).

This action lowers the top half of the screen, making it easily reachable with your thumb. So, you can use your iPhone as you always have. All the apps will open in the shifted-down screen until you deactivate the mode.

Now, you may wonder how to open Control Center or Notification Center in Reachability mode, as it needs you to swipe down from the top of the iPhone screen. Don’t worry; even with Reachability activated, you can still access these essential features:

  • To open Control Center: Swipe down from the top-right corner of the screen while Reachability is active.

  • To go to Notification Center: Swipe down from the top-center of the screen after enabling Reachability.

Apple has designed accessibility so that you can comfortably use one hand to do everything on your iPhone.

Once you have finished using Reachability, exit this mode by tapping the up-arrow icon at the top of the screen. It will return the frame to full screen.

Signing off…

Reachability is one of the simple but powerful features that can make using your iPhone much easier, especially when you’re on the go or multitasking. It ensures you can access everything with one hand. So, if you have not used the feature yet, enable it and have a comfortable iPhone experience!

FAQs

Does Reachability work in all apps?

Reachability can be used in nearly all of the native iPhone apps and several third-party apps that adhere to Apple’s UI guidelines. Unfortunately, some apps that use custom interfaces might not work well with Reachability.

Is there a way to customize Reachability settings?

Unfortunately, Reachability does not offer customization options. However, you can adjust related Accessibility features under Settings > Accessibility > Touch to enhance usability.

Why isn’t Reachability working on my iPhone?

If Reachability isn’t working, ensure it is enabled under Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Reachability. Restart your iPhone, as minor software glitches can prevent it from functioning. Additionally, check if your iPhone’s screen protector or case is interfering with touch gestures near the bottom edge.

Also read:

  • How to keep your iPhone screen on for a longer time
  • How to use Guided Access on iPhone and iPad

mainEntity.name: What is Apple Music authorization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Music authorization connects your Mac or any device to your Apple Account, so you can access your purchased music and synced libraries. It’s particularly useful when you’re subscribed to Apple Music and have purchased content, which you don’t want to be accessible for everyone with access to your Apple Account-linked device.

mainEntity.name: Why is my Mac not authorized to play music?

acceptedAnswer.text: This might be because you haven’t authorized your Mac yet, or you’ve hit the limit of five authorized devices. You can reset the limit by deauthorizing devices you don't need by hitting the Deauthorize All button under Account > Account Settings > Computer Authorizations.

mainEntity.name: Does deauthorizing my Mac delete my music or playlists?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, deauthorizing only revokes access to your Apple ID on that Mac. Your music and playlists will still be safe in your account and on other authorized devices.

title.rendered: Best cricket games for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Fondly known as the gentleman’s game, cricket originated in the 16th century and continues to capture hearts worldwide. So you’ve got to try some of the best cricket games for iPhone and iPad that simulate the experience. From building your skills to helping your team advance and winning trophies, you can enjoy it virtually! It’s the perfect solution when you can’t be out on the field yourself. So warm up your hands, get ready to spin the ball, and strike some boundaries in these best cricket games for iPhone.

Table of Contents
  1. Real Cricket™ 24
  2. Sachin Saga Cricket Champions
  3. World Cricket Championship 2
  4. Stick Cricket Super League
  5. New Star Cricket
  6. Smashing Cricket

    1. Real Cricket™ 24

    The all-new pro cam in this cricket game allows you to play from the batsman’s viewpoint and experience the thrill of the ball hurtling towards you at 90 miles per hour! Further, you get to enjoy authentic stadiums that give you that realistic gameplay experience.

    One of the most unique and noteworthy aspects of this app is that it offers female commentary, which is a first for sports games in my experience! Full points for inclusivity. At the same time, it’s challenging enough for pro players and offers top-notch simulation that keeps you hooked.

    Price: Free

    Download

    2. Sachin Saga Cricket Champions

    This top iOS cricket game lets you play in realtime with 14 Million Players across the world! You get to take on the renowned Sachin Tendulkar’s role to rack up those runs and smash some boundaries. Moreover, you get to play his iconic matches in the same settings and stadiums as he did.

    I enjoyed the story format of the game wherein you start as a young 16-year-old Sachin and then progress through his glorious cricketing journey. The high-end graphics and realistic animations made this game incredibly addictive for me. It supports all game formats, from test and one-day cricket to T20, the Indian Premier League, and World Cup. You can build your dream team and also collect player cards.

    Price: Free ($4.99 for Subscription Pack)

    Download

    3. World Cricket Championship 2

    Here’s a 3D cricket game that lets you hit all the famous shots unique to your favorite players. You can customize players and enjoy thrilling animations at real cricketing venues. Have fun playing different formats of the game with 18 international teams at 42 different stadiums.

    Further, cinematic cameras and dynamic lighting enhance the game’s visual appeal, making it more enticing to play. You can experience over 40+ in-game camera angles coupled with professional English and Hindi commentary, including ground sounds. Further, you can share and save game highlights generated at the end of the match. It doesn’t get more real than this!

    Price: Free

    Download

    4. Stick Cricket Super League

    I love this cricket game for the wide range of customization it offers, from making your players look precisely how you want them to, to building your team with stars from 70 world cities. You can even experience the game’s business side by negotiating seasonal contracts with the world’s best players.

    Check the career and season stats to track your progress. Along the way, you’ll win trophies and accolades to become the best of the best. And when things get repetitive and you get tired of watching, you can fast track the gameplay to the end of the innings. Pretty convenient! It’s easy to pick up but keeps challenging your skills which makes it addictive and fun!

    Price: Free (In-app token purchases to buy players)

    Download

    5. New Star Cricket

    It’s time to launch your virtual cricketing career as a promising young academy player. Build your skills and make your way to the pinnacle of the game, wielding your bat at competitions across the world. This game is a refreshing new venture from the makers of the hit New Star Soccer.

    I love how this game lets you vicariously experience life as a professional cricketer. As your career progresses, you have to manage not just your game but your relationships with others, keeping teammates, coaches, and sponsors happy. There are real dilemmas to face and exciting twists in the story that make this more than just a cricket game and a fun role-playing saga.

    Price: Free

    Download

    6. Smashing Cricket

    This cricket game for iPhone and iPad boasts a proprietary algorithm for bat-ball collision detection and realistic response. You can even watch your shots in mesmerizing super slow motion. It makes you feel like you’re part of an actual physical match!

    Moreover, you can choose from many camera angles and see closeups of the ball hitting the bat at super low replay speeds. The intuitive controls make it a breeze to play, even with just one hand. You can strike the ball with millisecond accuracy and test your eye-hand coordination. Further, the matrix grid control allows you to quickly pitch the ball wherever you like.

    Price: Free

    Download

    Best iPhone and iPad cricket games you should play!

    Have you tried any of these iOS cricket games yet? Share your favorites with me in the comments below! You might also like to try other sports games on your iPhone and iPad.

    You would like to read these posts as well:

    • Interactive story games for iPhone and iPad
    • Two player games for iPhone and iPad
    • Best racing games for iPhone and iPad

title.rendered: How to access clipboard on iPhone

content.rendered:
You’ve probably been told that when you copy something on your iPhone, it goes on your clipboard. But where is this iPhone clipboard? How can you access the clipboard on your iPhone and see what’s on it? Further, how can you view a history of items that were on your clipboard previously?

If you have faced these questions before, don’t worry. I’ll briefly explain how the iPhone clipboard works and show you a few ways to access the clipboard on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • Where is the clipboard on my iPhone?
  • How to access clipboard on iPhone using Notes
  • How to use clipboard history on iPhone with Shortcuts
  • Use a third-party keyboard to find iPhone clipboard history
    • Set up Microsoft SwiftKey
    • Use Microsoft SwiftKey clipboard
  • Use clipboard apps

Where is the clipboard on my iPhone?

In iOS, when you copy text, a link, or an image, it resides on a virtual clipboard for you to paste where you need it on your iPhone. So, there’s no app or window to open and view your clipboard on an iPhone.

Additionally, the clipboard stores the copied item until you copy a different one. This means that the iPhone clipboard only holds one item at a time and, thus, doesn’t offer history functionality.

Plus, if you use the Universal Clipboard to copy and paste between Apple devices, those contents are only available for a few minutes.

While you don’t have a simple way to see the iPhone’s clipboard contents or history, you can use a few workarounds. Depending on your needs, check out the following methods for accessing your clipboard contents on your iPhone.

How to access clipboard on iPhone using Notes

To quickly see what’s on your iPhone clipboard, you can simply paste the copied item into Apple Notes. 

  1. Open Notes on your iPhone → Select an existing note or create a new one.
  2. Tap and hold a spot in the note and choose Paste.
  3. You’ll see the item from your clipboard pop into the note so you can do what you like.

Bonus Tip: You can also consider using Notes to save your iPhone clipboard history. Simply paste those copied items you want to save in the same note, and you’ll have a running history to view any time you like.

How to use clipboard history on iPhone with Shortcuts

Another option to view and edit content on your iPhone clipboard is to use a shortcut called Adjust Clipboard.

With it, you just run the shortcut, and you’ll see your clipboard contents.

  1. Open the Shortcuts app.
  2. Go to the Gallery tab → Enter “Adjust Clipboard” into the search box at the top. 
  3. Select the shortcut in the results and tap the plus sign or Add Shortcut.

  4. Once you have the Adjust Clipboard shortcut, using it is easy. Copy the text. Then go to the Shortcuts app → Run the Adjust Clipboard shortcut in the Shortcuts app.

  5. You’ll then see your clipboard contents at the top of the screen.
    • The best part is, here, you can make edits to the clipboard content and save it by tapping Done. This saves the effort of copying the content again. After this, you can just paste the edited content wherever you like.

If you’re new to the Shortcuts app, check out our complete guide for using Shortcuts like a pro.

Use a third-party keyboard to find iPhone clipboard history

If you’ve never used a third-party keyboard on your iPhone, you might consider Microsoft SwiftKey for its handy clipboard feature.

Once you install the keyboard, you can not only view your clipboard contents, but save the items to reuse or to keep a history.

Set up Microsoft SwiftKey

  1. Download Microsoft SwiftKey AI Keyboard from the App Store to get started.
  2. To set up the keyboard, open Settings → General → pick Keyboard. 
  3. Tap Keyboards → Select Add New Keyboard → Search and pick SwiftKey.

  4. Select SwiftKey → Toggle on Allow Full Access and confirm by tapping Allow.

Use Microsoft SwiftKey clipboard

  1. Once you have Microsoft SwiftKey, set it up as another keyboard, open an app, and copy an item.
  2. To open the SwiftKey keyboard, tap and hold the globe icon on the bottom left of the Apple keyboard → Select SwiftKey.
    Alternatively, you can keep tapping the globe icon until SwiftKey appears.
  3. Tap the tools icon (four boxes) on the right → Select Clipboard → When using it for the first time, select Allow Paste.

  4. You’ll then see the current copied item from your clipboard. You can select it to paste it and use the Save option in the clipboard to keep the item in your history to paste it again later.

  5. You can also view your clipboard history and add items directly to the clipboard. To do that, open Microsoft SwiftKey → Select Settings → Tap Clipboard.

Additionally, consider taking advantage of other features offered by the Microsoft SwiftKey keyboard, like applying a theme, adjusting the settings, and viewing your typing stats. Simply open the app on your iPhone to see these and other options.

Use clipboard apps

If you search the App Store, you’ll find plenty of clipboard apps for your iPhone.

One app that gives you the basics you need, lets you organize copied items, and is completely free is Copy Better.

  1. Download Copy Better from the App Store to get started.
  2. Once installed, open the app and follow the prompts to enable those features you want to use.
  3. To use the app, copy an item and open Copy Better.
  4. You’ll be prompted to Allow the paste action, and then you can view the item in the Last Copied note.

  5. You can also save your pasted items with names, create folders to organize your items and copy a saved item simply by tapping Copy at the top.

Your iPhone clipboard does exist!

If you’re someone who copies and pastes items often, being able to see what’s currently on your clipboard, or even what was on it yesterday, can be a huge productivity boost and time saver. 

Are these methods for accessing the clipboard on iPhone and managing its history just what you’ve been looking for? Let us know!

  • 25+ Best Keyboard tips and tricks for iPhone and iPad
  • How to copy and save Mac screenshots to clipboard

mainEntity.name: What is Apple Music authorization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Music authorization connects your Mac or any device to your Apple Account, so you can access your purchased music and synced libraries. It’s particularly useful when you’re subscribed to Apple Music and have purchased content, which you don’t want to be accessible for everyone with access to your Apple Account-linked device.

acceptedAnswer.text: This might be because you haven’t authorized your Mac yet, or you’ve hit the limit of five authorized devices. You can reset the limit by deauthorizing devices you don't need by hitting the Deauthorize All button under Account > Account Settings > Computer Authorizations.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of now, Apple hasn't officially revealed anything regarding UV sanitizers damaging iPhones. But in an Apple support thread, a user reported Apple Support suggested not to use UV sanitizers on iPhones as it may cause damage.

mainEntity.name: Does Reachability work in all apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reachability can be used in nearly all of the native iPhone apps and several third-party apps that adhere to Apple's UI guidelines. Unfortunately, some apps that use custom interfaces might not work well with Reachability.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to customize Reachability settings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, Reachability does not offer customization options. However, you can adjust related Accessibility features under Settings > Accessibility > Touch to enhance usability.

mainEntity.name: Why isn't Reachability working on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: If Reachability isn't working, ensure it is enabled under Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Reachability. Restart your iPhone, as minor software glitches can prevent it from functioning. Additionally, check if your iPhone's screen protector or case is interfering with touch gestures near the bottom edge.

title.rendered: Best telescopes for iPhone to explore the night sky in 2026

content.rendered:
There’s nothing that compares to the feeling of stargazing on a clear night and beholding the twinkling mysteries of the universe. A telescope is a dream invention because it helps us get a closer look at the celestial wonders. And did you know that you can use telescopes with your iPhone too? This makes it possible to capture amazing photographs of the moon, stars, and planets.  Moreover, you can also use it to observe and record animals, birds, landscapes, etc.

If that sounds appealing, take your pick from these best telescopes for iPhone to explore the night sky. They’re a must for any astrophotographer’s toolkit!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Celestron Inspire Refracting Telescope – Best for avid photographers
  • 2. MAXLAPTER Astronomy Telescope – Most easy to use
  • 3. HUTACT telescope for iPhone – Best stability and control
  • 4. AOMEKIE telescope for iPhone- Best for multiple views
  • 5. ESSLNB Astronomy telescope – Best for gifting
  • 6. OYS fully multi-coated optics telescope – Best for kids
  • 7. SARBLUE Maksutov-Cassegrain telescope – Best design
    • Explore the universe with these best telescopes for iPhone!

1. Celestron Inspire Refracting Telescope – Best for avid photographers

Specifications:

  • Aperture: 100 mm
  • Lens coating: Fully coated
  • Item weight: 20 Pounds
  • Warranty: N/A

This refractor telescope includes two 1.25″ telescope eyepieces (K20mm and K9mm) for 20X and 44X magnification. The 5×24 finder scope makes locating objects easier. And the diagonal prism ensures you get a sharp image, ideal for both celestial and terrestrial viewing.

It’s easy to set up, and the main telescope lens cap comes with a fully integrated smartphone adapter built-in, perfect for budding astrophotographers. The asymmetrical mount design offers lightweight and incredible stability. The top-notch image optics enables a correct image for easy viewing day or night, terrestrial or celestial.

Check out on Amazon

2. MAXLAPTER Astronomy Telescope – Most easy to use

Technical specifications:

  • Aperture: 70 mm
  • Lens coating: Fully coated
  • Item weight: 4 Pounds
  • Warranty: 2 years

This travel telescope has got a 400mm(f/5.7) focal length and 70mm aperture with a fully coated optical glass lens that enhances the brightness of celestial objects. 98% light transmission helps to protect your eyes. It comes with two replaceable eyepieces that offer the ideal power for moon watching at 16x and 67x.

Further, the 5×24 finderscope and erect-image diagonal mirror make it easier to locate things, allowing you to observe celestial objects at night and terrestrial scenery like wildlife and landscapes during the day.

Check out on Amazon

3. HUTACT telescope for iPhone – Best stability and control

Technical specifications:

  • Aperture: 70 mm
  • Lens coating: Coated
  • Item weight: 5.19 Pounds
  • Warranty: Lifetime

Here’s a telescope that can be used to observe celestial bodies and other landscapes, such as stargazing, moon watching, city night scenes, event performances, bird watching, outdoor scenery, etc. It features an upgraded optical glass coating and a 70mm aperture and 400mm focal length for a clearer view.

Further, the tripod is really stable, and the height and angle can be adjusted according to changes in the moon. Besides, the wired phone controller is more stable than Bluetooth control and will not miss any scenery you want to record. The 360° panoramic photography allows you to check out different viewing angles.

Check out on Amazon

4. AOMEKIE telescope for iPhone- Best for multiple views

Technical specifications:

  • Aperture: 70 mm
  • Lens coating: Fully multi-coated
  • Item weight: 4.47 Pounds
  • Warranty: N/A

The all-optical glass lens of this telescope offers excellent contrast and brightness of view while protecting your eyes. It can reduce longitudinal chromatic aberration and distortion as well as correct lateral chromatic aberration, which is a fantastic astronomical telescope for kids, adults, and beginners to explore space.

The height of the aluminum tripod can be adjusted from about 15 inches to 51 inches. Further, it allows many different observational positions while remaining steady for hassle-free use. The 70mm aperture objective lens makes the images brighter and clearer, allowing for a large field of view.

Check out on Amazon

5. ESSLNB Astronomy telescope – Best for gifting

Technical specifications:

  • Aperture: 80 mm
  • Lens coating: Fully coated
  • Item weight: 8.48 Pounds
  • Warranty: N/A

Here’s an excellent iPhone telescope that boasts bright image quality and high magnification power. It’s ideally suitable for children, beginners, and anyone interested in astronomy. During the day, it’s perfect for observing birds, animals, or landscapes.

The specifications offer 16X-133X magnification, and the lens is adjustable by 180 degrees in a vertical direction and by 360 ° in a horizontal direction thanks to the included tripod. Further, the moon filter protects your eyes, and a handy map of the sky helps you identify celestial objects.

Check out on Amazon

6. OYS fully multi-coated optics telescope – Best for kids

Technical specifications:

  • Aperture: 70 mm
  • Lens coating: Fully coated
  • Item weight: 2.2 Pounds
  • Warranty: Lifetime

This telescope features 400mm (f/5.7) focal length and a large 70mm aperture. The multi-coated optical glass with high transmission creates stunning images with increased brightness and clarity. It is quick and easy to set up and comes with a phone adapter with a 10mm eyepiece to capture some fantastic celestial images.

Further, it’s lightweight and can be conveniently carried around in the custom backpack that’s included. The adjustable tripod adds to the usability. The brand also offers friendly customer service and a lifetime warranty so that you can buy with confidence.

Check out on Amazon

7. SARBLUE Maksutov-Cassegrain telescope – Best design

Technical specifications:

  • Aperture: 70 mm
  • Lens coating: Fully coated
  • Item weight: 2.62 Pounds
  • Warranty: 1 year

Here’s another beginner’s telescope that’s much more powerful than it looks! Thanks to the Maksutov-Cassegrain design and the high-precision fully multi-coated optical glass lens, both spherical and chromatic aberrations are minimized.

It delivers vivid high-contrast images for daytime viewings such as birds and wildlife and nighttime explorations of the moon, Saturn, Jupiter, and the stars. The included high-quality 20mm wide eyepiece brings 37.5X magnification, providing sharp high-power views on distant objects. You can see any targets more than 8 meters away. Accessories also include a phone adapter, a tabletop tripod, and an erect-image diagonal.

Check out on Amazon

Explore the universe with these best telescopes for iPhone!

Tried a telescope with your iPhone yet? Share your experience with me in the comments below. I think astrophotography is a fascinating pursuit, and I’m looking forward to spending more time outside under clear skies taking in the beauty of the world up above!

title.rendered: What is Shake to Undo on iPhone and how to disable it

content.rendered:
The Shake to Undo feature on iOS can be both a blessing and a nuisance for iPhone users. As the name suggests, the feature prompts you to undo your recent action with the shake of your iPhone.

While Share to Undo is pretty useful in most instances, its sensitive nature can cause it to trigger accidentally. So, if you are also annoyed with unintended Shake to Undo triggers, keep reading to learn how to disable Shake to Undo on an iPhone. We will also share some alternatives to Shake to Undo that you can use to undo actions on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • What is Shake to Undo on iPhone?
  • Why you might want to turn off Shake to Undo?
  • How to disable Shake to Undo on your iPhone
  • Alternatives to Shake to Undo
    • Method 1: Use finger gestures
    • Method 2: Use the undo and redo buttons on iPad
    • Method 3: Use in-app undo and redo buttons
    • Method 4: Use keyboard shortcut

What is Shake to Undo on iPhone?

Shake to Undo is an accessibility feature that lets you undo your most recent text input or certain actions when you shake your iPhone. This feature is beneficial when you type something or delete text by mistake.

Apple specifically designed this feature to help users with limited dexterity, thinking that shaking the iPhone may be easier than performing complex gestures such as swiping with three fingers or tapping the small on-screen buttons.

However, to a lot of users’ dismay, this feature can quickly get annoying as it often triggers unintentionally, especially if you’re on the move, using your iPhone in a bumpy environment, or are simply clumsy like me.

Why you might want to turn off Shake to Undo?

Now that you know that the Shake to Undo feature is something that Apple has designed for users with limited dexterity, there is no reason why this feature is auto-enabled by default for all users. Here are some common reasons why you might want to turn off Shake to Undo on your iPhone:

  • Accidental activation: As already mentioned, the feature is susceptible to getting triggered even with minimal shake, showering you with Undo pop-ups, which can frustrate you when you don’t intend to use it. So, it is wise to disable it for good and end your frustration.
  • Less interruption: There are times when tapping the Undo button doesn’t even do anything, instead of putting the deleted text back as you would assume. Besides this, Shake to Undo sometimes interrupts the Shake to Reveal feature in Instagram stories.
  • Improved accessibility: Certain users with motor disability can find it difficult to interact with the accidental triggers of Shake to Undo.

How to disable Shake to Undo on your iPhone

  1. Open the Settings app and head to Accessibility.
  2. Locate and tap on Touch under the Physical and Motor section.
  3. Finally, toggle off the Shake to Undo option.

Alternatives to Shake to Undo

Even if you disable Shake to Undo, various other quick methods exist that you can use to undo a text input. Let’s check them out.

Method 1: Use finger gestures

You can simply undo and redo text on your iPhone with a three-finger swipe on the display. All you need to do is make a three-finger left swipe to undo the text. To redo, perform a three-finger right swipe.

Alternatively, if the three-finger swipe is a bit complicated for you, you can also do a three-finger tap to return the text to its previous version. Check out our detailed guide on how to undo and redo text on iPhone for better understanding.

Method 2: Use the undo and redo buttons on iPad

Undoing and redoing text is much easier for users with iPads than for iPhone users, as you get the dedicated undo and redo buttons at the top left corner of your iPad’s keyboard. Simply tap the needed button, and the iPadOS will handle the rest.

Method 3: Use in-app undo and redo buttons

Most first-party apps, such as Notes and Pages, have dedicated undo and redo buttons embedded in their user interface to make note-taking a breeze. The curved arrow icons represent the undo and redo actions and tapping them would do the job.

While both buttons are usually available to the naked eye, there is a slim chance you may notice that the redo button is missing. In that case, simply press and hold the undo button, and the redo button will appear in a pop-out menu.

Method 4: Use keyboard shortcut

If you prefer using a physical keyboard with your iPhone or iPad, you can use the usual Command+Z shortcut to undo changes and Command+Shift+Z to redo changes (works only in certain apps), similar to how to undo and redo text on your Mac.

Summing up…

The Shake to Undo feature is handy for some but unnecessary for others. So, there is no point in keeping it enabled when you use it rarely or keep getting annoyed due to the uninvited Undo pop-ups. Disabling Shake to Undo on your iPhone will help you get rid of unwanted interruptions so you can better focus on the task at hand.

What do you think about the Shake to Undo feature on iPhone and iPad? Do share your thoughts in the comments below.

mainEntity.name: What is Apple Music authorization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Music authorization connects your Mac or any device to your Apple Account, so you can access your purchased music and synced libraries. It’s particularly useful when you’re subscribed to Apple Music and have purchased content, which you don’t want to be accessible for everyone with access to your Apple Account-linked device.

mainEntity.name: Why is my Mac not authorized to play music?

acceptedAnswer.text: This might be because you haven’t authorized your Mac yet, or you’ve hit the limit of five authorized devices. You can reset the limit by deauthorizing devices you don't need by hitting the Deauthorize All button under Account > Account Settings > Computer Authorizations.

mainEntity.name: Does deauthorizing my Mac delete my music or playlists?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, deauthorizing only revokes access to your Apple ID on that Mac. Your music and playlists will still be safe in your account and on other authorized devices.
